import { FC, memo, useState, useEffect } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";

import InputNumber from "../InputNumber";

import { IInputProps } from "./types";

import styles from "./Input.module.sass";

import { MAX_VALUE_ERROR_MESSAGE, MAX_VALUE_NUMBER } from "./store";

const Input: FC<IInputProps> = ({
  addonAfter,
  addonBefore,
  className,
  classNameInput,
  disabled,
  error,
  id,
  label,
  maxValue = MAX_VALUE_NUMBER,
  maxValueOnlyWarning,
  onChange,
  onBlur,
  onFocus,
  onClick,
  placeholder,
  type = "text",
  value,
  warning,
  withButtons,
  mode = "default",
}) => {
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState(value);

  useEffect(() => {
    setInputValue(disabled ? "" : value);
  }, [disabled, value]);

  const btnPlusHandler = e => {
    const currValue = inputValue || 0;
    if (
      (+currValue < maxValue && !maxValueOnlyWarning) ||
      maxValueOnlyWarning
    ) {
      const newValue = +currValue + 1;
      setInputValue(newValue);
      e.target.value = newValue;
      onChange && onChange(e);
    }
  };

  const btnMinusHandler = e => {
    const currValue = inputValue || 0;
    if (+currValue > 0) {
      const newValue = +currValue - 1;
      setInputValue(newValue);
      e.target.value = newValue;
      onChange && onChange(e);
    }
  };

  const onChangeHandler = e => {
    if (type === "number") {
      e.target.value = e.target.value.replace(/[^0123456789]/g, "");
      if (+e.target.value > maxValue && !maxValueOnlyWarning) {
        setInputValue(maxValue);
        e.target.value = maxValue;
      } else if (+e.target.value < 0) {
        setInputValue(0);
        e.target.value = 0;
      } else {
        setInputValue(e.target.value);
      }
    } else if (type === "text" && mode === "code") {
      e.target.value = e.target.value
        .replace(/[^0123456789]/g, "")
        .slice(0, maxValue.toString().length);
      setInputValue(e.target.value);
    } else {
      // Для date и других типов просто сохраняем значение
      setInputValue(e.target.value);
    }
    onChange && onChange(e);
  };

  const maxValueError = typeof inputValue === "number" && inputValue > maxValue && inputValue > 0;

  const classNamesInputContainer = cn(
    styles["input-container"],
    disabled && styles["input-container--disabled"],
    !disabled && styles["input-container--hover"],
    addonAfter && styles["input-container--addon-after"],
    classNameInput,
  );

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(styles.input, {
        [styles["input--theme-warning"]]: warning,
        [styles["input--theme-error"]]: error,
        [styles["input--disabled"]]: disabled,
        [styles["input--theme-max-value-warning"]]:
          maxValueError && maxValueOnlyWarning,
        [className]: className,
      })}
    >
      <div className={styles.inputGroup}>
        <label>
          {label && <span className={styles.label}>{label}</span>}

          <div className={classNamesInputContainer} tabIndex={0}>
            {type === "number" ? (
              <InputNumber
                allowNegative={false}
                decimalScale={0}
                disabled={disabled}
                onBlur={onBlur}
                onChange={onChangeHandler}
                placeholder={placeholder}
                value={inputValue}
              />
            ) : (
              <input
                disabled={disabled}
                id={id}
                onBlur={onBlur}
                onClick={onClick}
                onFocus={onFocus}
                onChange={onChangeHandler}
                placeholder={placeholder}
                type={type}
                value={inputValue || ""}
              />
            )}

            {addonAfter && (
              <div
                className={cn(
                  styles["addon-after"],
                  disabled && styles["addon-after--disabled"],
                )}
              >
                {addonAfter}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </label>

        {type === "number" && withButtons && (
          <>
            <span className={styles.button} {...(!disabled && { onClick: btnMinusHandler })}>
              -
            </span>
            <span className={styles.button} {...(!disabled && { onClick: btnPlusHandler })}>
              +
            </span>
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {(error || warning) && (
        <div className={styles.errorMessage}>{error || warning}</div>
      )}

      {maxValueError && (
        <span className={styles.errorMessage}>
          {MAX_VALUE_ERROR_MESSAGE(maxValue)}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(Input);


--- FILE: src/components/Input/store.ts ---
export const MAX_VALUE_ERROR_MESSAGE = max =>
  `Некорректное значение. Возможно указать не более ${max} шт`;

export const MAX_VALUE_NUMBER = 10000000;

export const NUMBER_PATTERN = "[0-9]{0,9}";

export const NUMBER_TITLE = "Разрешено использовать только цифры"


--- FILE: src/components/Input/types.ts ---
import { ChangeEventHandler, HTMLInputTypeAttribute, ReactNode } from "react";

export interface IInputProps<Element = HTMLInputElement> {
  /** дополнительный контент слева */
  addonBefore?: React.ReactNode;
  /** дополнительный контент справа */
  addonAfter?: React.ReactNode;  
  className?: string;
  classNameInput?: string;
  error?: string | ReactNode;
  id?: string;
  label?: ReactNode;
  disabled?: boolean;
  maxValue?: number;
  maxValueOnlyWarning?: boolean;
  onChange?: ChangeEventHandler<Element>;
  onClick?: () => void;
  onFocus?: () => void;
  onBlur?: ChangeEventHandler<Element>;
  placeholder?: string;
  type?: HTMLInputTypeAttribute;
  value?: string | number;
  warning?: string;
  withButtons?: boolean;
  mode?: "default" | "code";
}


--- FILE: src/components/InputNewPassword/helpers.ts ---
export const calcPasswordStrength = (password: string) => {
  const numEx = /\d/;
  const lcEx = /[a-z]/;
  const ucEx = /[A-Z]/;
  const syEx = /\W/;
  let character_set_size = 0;

  // loop over each char of the password and check it per regexes above.
  // weight numbers, upper case and lowercase at .75, 1 and .25 respectively.
  if (numEx.test(password)) {
    character_set_size += 10;
  }
  if (ucEx.test(password)) {
    character_set_size += 26;
  }
  if (lcEx.test(password)) {
    character_set_size += 26;
  }
  if (syEx.test(password)) {
    character_set_size += 32;
  }

  // assume that 100% is a meterMult of maxMulti
  const strength = Math.pow(character_set_size, password.length);

  // init crackers at hashes/second
  // all numbers from slowest computer here http://hashcat.net/oclhashcat-plus/
  const rateSHA1 = 433_000_000;

  // calculate a human readable time based on seconds and nodes
  const secSHA1 = Math.floor(strength / rateSHA1 / 86_400);

  return secSHA1 <= 3 ? 1 : secSHA1 <= 7 ? 2 : 3;
};

export const validatePassword = (password: string, pattern: string) => new RegExp(pattern).test(password);

import React, { ChangeEvent, useCallback, useState } from 'react';

import { IInputProps } from '../Input/types';

import InputPassword from '../InputPassword';

import { validatePassword } from './helpers';
import { IPasswordPolicy } from '../../entities/auth/auth.types';

type InputNewPasswordProps = Omit<IInputProps, 'onChange' | 'value'> & {
  value: string;
  onChange: (ev: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>, minReqMet: boolean) => void;
  policyProps: IPasswordPolicy | null;
};

const InputNewPassword: React.FC<InputNewPasswordProps> = ({ value, onChange, policyProps, ...props }) => {
  const [passDescription, setPassDescription] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [status, setStatus] = useState<string>();

  const { Pattern: pattern, ErrorMessage: errorMessage } = policyProps || {};

  const handleChange = useCallback((event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    let minReqMet = false;
    const { value } = event.target;
    if (value) {
      if (pattern && validatePassword(value, pattern)) {
        minReqMet = true;
        setStatus('success');
      } else {
        setPassDescription(errorMessage || 'Пароль не удовлетворяет политике безопасности');
        setStatus('error');
      }
    } else {
      setPassDescription('Пароль не может быть пустым');
      setStatus('error');
    }
    onChange && onChange(event, minReqMet);
  }, [errorMessage, onChange, pattern]);

  return (
    <InputPassword
      {...props}
      value={value}
      error={status === "error" ? passDescription : null}
      onChange={handleChange}
      disabled={!pattern || props.disabled}
    />
  );
};

export default InputNewPassword;

import { FC, memo } from "react";

import { NumberFormatValues, NumericFormat } from "react-number-format";

import { InputNumberProps } from "./types";

const InputNumber:FC<InputNumberProps> = ({ 
  allowNegative,
  decimalSeparator = ',',
  disabled, 
  placeholder, 
  decimalScale = 2, 
  rules, 
  suffix, 
  value, 
  onBlur, 
  onChange,
}) => {
  const currentSuffix = suffix !== undefined ? ` ${suffix}` : suffix;

  const isAllowed = (value: NumberFormatValues) => 
    rules ? rules.every(rule => rule(value)) : true;
    
  return (
    <NumericFormat
      allowNegative={allowNegative}
      decimalScale={decimalScale}
      decimalSeparator={decimalScale ? decimalSeparator : undefined}
      disabled={disabled}
      displayType="input"
      isAllowed={isAllowed}
      suffix={currentSuffix}
      thousandSeparator=" "
      value={value}
      onBlur={onBlur}
      onChange={onChange}
      placeholder={placeholder}
    />
  );
};

export default memo(InputNumber);

import { forwardRef, useState } from "react";

import Input from "../Input";
import cx from "classnames";

import {ReactComponent as IconEye} from "../../icons/icon-eye.svg";
import {ReactComponent as IconEyeClosed} from "../../icons/icon-eye-closed.svg";

import { IInputPasswordProps } from "./types";

import styles from "./InputPassword.module.sass";

const InputPassword = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, IInputPasswordProps>(
  ({ disabled, onChange, value, ...rest }, ref) => {
    const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
    const [typeInput, setTypeInput] = useState<"password" | "text">("password");

    const handleClick = () => {
      setShowPassword(!showPassword);
      setTypeInput(typeInput === "password" ? "text" : "password");
    };

    return (
      <Input
        addonAfter={
          <div
            className={cx(
              styles.icon,
              disabled && ["icon--pointer-events-off"],
            )}
            onClick={handleClick}
          >
            {showPassword ? <IconEyeClosed /> : <IconEye />}
          </div>
        }
        onChange={onChange}
        type={typeInput}
        value={value}
        {...rest}
      />
    );
  },
);

export default InputPassword;

import { FC } from "react";
import { useDispatch } from "react-redux";
import { useNavigate, useMatches } from "react-router-dom";

import cn from "classnames";

import { saveLang } from "../../entities/lang/lang.slice";
import { useLangData } from "../../entities/lang/lang.selectors";

import { ILangSwitcherProps } from "./types";

import styles from "./LangSwitcher.module.sass";

const LangSwitcher: FC<ILangSwitcherProps> = ({ className }) => {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const { lang } = useLangData();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  let matches = useMatches();

  const langHandler = () => {
    const currLang = lang === "ru" ? "en" : "ru";
    dispatch(saveLang(currLang));
    sessionStorage.setItem("lang", currLang);

    if (matches[0].params.section) {
      navigate("/");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(styles.langSwitcher, styles[`langSwitcher--${lang}`], {
        [className]: className,
      })}
      onClick={langHandler}
    >
      <span className={styles.ru}>ru</span> |{" "}
      <span className={styles.en}>en</span>
    </div>
  );
};
export default LangSwitcher;

}

import { Link, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useDispatch } from "react-redux";

import { FC, memo } from "react";

import cn from "classnames";

import Portal from "../Portal";

import { useLangData } from "../../entities/lang/lang.selectors";
import { useMenu } from "../../entities/menu/menu.selectors";
import { toogleMenu } from "../../entities/menu/menu.slice";

import styles from "./Navigation.module.sass";

import { NAVIGATION } from "./store";

import { INavigationProps } from "./types";

const Navigation: FC<INavigationProps> = ({ className, lineType }) => {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const { lang } = useLangData();
  const { isMenuOpen } = useMenu();
  const location = useLocation();

  const navigation = NAVIGATION[lang];

  const mobileNavigation = [...navigation.firstLine, ...navigation.secondLine];

  return lineType === "firstLine" ? (
    <>
      <div
        className={cn(styles.navigation, styles.navigationDesktop, {
          [className]: className,
        })}
      >
        {navigation.firstLine.map(el => (
          <Link
            key={el.title}
            className={cn(styles.item, {
              [styles.itemActive]: location?.pathname === el.link,
            })}
            to={el.link}
          >
            {el.title}
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div
        className={cn(styles.navigation, styles.navigationMobile, {
          [className]: className,
        })}
      >
        {!isMenuOpen ? (
          <div
            className={styles.burger}
            onClick={() => dispatch(toogleMenu(true))}
          />
        ) : (
          <div
            className={styles.close}
            onClick={() => dispatch(toogleMenu(false))}
          />
        )}

        {isMenuOpen && (
          <Portal>
            <div
              className={styles.navigationPopupWrapper}
              onClick={() => dispatch(toogleMenu(false))}
            >
              <div className={styles.navigationPopup}>
                {mobileNavigation.map(el => (
                  <Link
                    key={el.title}
                    className={cn(styles.item, {
                      [styles.itemActive]: location?.pathname === el.link,
                    })}
                    to={el.link}
                  >
                    {el.title}
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </Portal>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  ) : (
    <div
      className={cn(
        styles.navigation,
        styles.navigationDesktop,
        styles.secondLine,
      )}
    >
      {navigation.secondLine.map(el => (
        <Link
          key={el.title}
          className={cn(styles.item, {
            [styles.itemActive]: location?.pathname === el.link,
          })}
          to={el.link}
        >
          {el.title}
        </Link>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};
export default memo(Navigation);

import React, { FC } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";

import { ISectionProps } from "./types";

import styles from "./Section.module.sass";

/**
 * Контейнер для регулировки отступов по вертикали в секции
 */
const Section: FC<ISectionProps> = ({
  children,
  className,
  id,
  paddingBottom,
  paddingTop,
  theme,
  withBorderBottom,
}) => (
  <div
    className={cn(styles.section, {
      [styles[`section--theme-${theme}`]]: theme,
      [styles[`section--padding-bottom-${paddingBottom}`]]: paddingBottom,
      [styles[`section--padding-top-${paddingTop}`]]: paddingTop,
      [styles["section--with-border-bottom"]]: withBorderBottom,
      [className]: className,
    })}
    {...(id && { id: id })}
  >
    {children}
  </div>
);

export default Section;

}

--- FILE: src/components/Tabs/Tabs.tsx ---
import { FC, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";

import { ITabsProps } from "./types";

import styles from "./Tabs.module.sass";

const Tabs: FC<ITabsProps> = ({ items, className }) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(0);

  const Tabs = useMemo(
    () =>
      items.map((tab, index) => (
        <div
          key={tab.label}
          className={cn(styles.content, {
            [styles.activeContent]: activeTab === index,
          })}
        >
          {tab.content}
        </div>
      )),
    [activeTab, items],
  );

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(styles.tabs, {
        [className]: className,
      })}
    >
      <div className={styles.labels}>
        {items.map((tab, index) => (
          <div
            key={index}
            className={cn(styles.label, {
              [styles.activeTab]: activeTab === index,
            })}
            onClick={() => setActiveTab(index)}
          >
            {tab.label}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {Tabs[activeTab]}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Tabs;

  items: IItemProps[];
  className?: string;
}

export interface IItemProps {
  label: string;
  content: ReactNode;
}

import React, { FC, createElement, memo } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";

import { ITextProps } from "./types";

import styles from "./Text.module.sass";

/**
 * Компонент текста
 */
const Text: FC<ITextProps> = ({
  children,
  className,
  color,
  fontVariant,
  size,
  tag = "p",
}) => {
  const isStringContent = typeof children === "string";

  const props = {
    className: cn(styles.text, {
      [styles[`text--size-${size}`]]: size,
      [styles[`text--color-${color}`]]: color,
      [styles[`text--fontVariant-${fontVariant}`]]: fontVariant,
      [className]: className,
    }),
  };

  const content = isStringContent ? (
    <span dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: children }} />
  ) : (
    children
  );

  return createElement(tag, props, content);
};

export default memo(Text);


--- FILE: src/components/Text/types.ts ---
import { ReactNode } from "react";

export type TTextColor = "light" | "dark" | "brand" | "brand-light" | "gray";
type TTextTag = "p" | "span";
type TTextSize = "s" | "m" | "l";
type TTextFontVariant = "bold" | "semibold" | "medium" | "regular";

export interface ITextProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  color?: TTextColor;
  fontVariant?: TTextFontVariant;
  size?: TTextSize;
  tag?: TTextTag;
}

import { FC, memo } from "react";

const Warning: FC<IWarningProps> = ({
  className,
  title = DEFAULT_WARNING_TITLE,
  subtitle,
  type = "warning",
  warningText
}) => (
  <div
    className={cn(styles.warning, {
      [styles[`warning--type-${type}`]]: type,
      [className]: className,
    })}
  >
    <WarningSvg />
    <div className={styles.warningContent}>
      <span className={styles.title}>{title}</span>
      <span className={styles.subtitle}>{subtitle}</span>
      <span className={styles.warningText}>{warningText}</span>
    </div>
  </div>
);

export default memo(Warning);

import { FC, memo, useEffect } from "react";

import cn from "classnames";

import { useNavigation, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useDispatch } from "react-redux";
import ScrollToAnchor from "../../utils/scrollToAnchor";

import { saveLang } from "../../entities/lang/lang.slice";
import { useMenu } from "../../entities/menu/menu.selectors";

import { toogleMenu } from "../../entities/menu/menu.slice";

import Header from "./../../components/Header";
import Footer from "./../../components/Footer";

import { IPageContainerProps } from "./types";

import styles from "./PageContainer.module.sass";

const PageContainer: FC<IPageContainerProps> = ({ children, withoutMenu, withoutHeader }) => {
  const { state } = useNavigation();
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const { isMenuOpen } = useMenu();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();

  useEffect(() => {
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    const lang = sessionStorage.getItem("lang");
    if (lang) {
      dispatch(saveLang(lang));
    }
    dispatch(toogleMenu(false));
  }, [dispatch, pathname]);

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(styles.pageContainer, {
        [styles.menuOpen]: isMenuOpen,
      })}
    >
      <ScrollToAnchor />
      {!withoutHeader && <Header withoutMenu={withoutMenu} />}

      <div className={styles.pageContainerContent}>{children}</div>

      <Footer />
      {state === "loading" && <div className={styles.loader} />}
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(PageContainer);

--- FILE: src/containers/ProductPages/AcceptPopup/AcceptPopup.tsx ---
import { FC, memo } from "react";

import Button from "./../../../components/Button";
import SectionWithWrapper from "./../../../components/SectionWithWrapper";
import Headline from "./../../../components/Headline";
import Text from "./../../../components/Text";

import PageContainer from "../../PageContainer";
import { useLangData } from "../../../entities/lang/lang.selectors";

import styles from "./AcceptPopup.module.sass";

import {
  BUTTON_ACCEPT_VALUE,
  BUTTON_DECLINE_VALUE,
  DISCLAIMER,
  SUBTITLE,
  TITLE,
} from "./store";


const AcceptPopup: FC = () => {
  const { lang } = useLangData();
  
  const onAccept = () => {
    sessionStorage.setItem("accept", "accepted");
    document.location.reload();
  };

  const onDecline = () => {
    document.location.reload();
  };

  return (
    <PageContainer withoutMenu={true}>
      <SectionWithWrapper
        sectionProps={{
          paddingTop: "l",
          paddingBottom: "l",
        }}
        wrapperProps={{ className: styles.acceptPopup }}
      >
        <Headline className={styles.title} size="h1" tag="h2">
          {TITLE[lang]}
        </Headline>
        <Text className={styles.subtitle}>{SUBTITLE[lang]}</Text>
        <Text className={styles.disclaimer}>{DISCLAIMER[lang]}</Text>
        <div className={styles.buttons}>
          <Button
            className={styles.button}
            onClick={onAccept}
            title={BUTTON_ACCEPT_VALUE[lang]}
            theme="accent"
          />
          <Button
            className={styles.button}
            onClick={onDecline}
            title={BUTTON_DECLINE_VALUE[lang]}
            theme="light"
          />
        </div>
      </SectionWithWrapper>
    </PageContainer>
  );
};

export default memo(AcceptPopup);

        OF FOREIGN SECURITIES BY THE TRANSACTION ORGANISER) IS NOT ADDRESSED TO
        U.S. PERSONS (IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE DEFINITION GIVEN IN REGULATION S OF
        THE U.S. SECURITIES ACT OF 1933, AS AMENDED AND SUPPLEMENTED) AND

        THE HOLDERS, NON-RESIDENT BUYERS, FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES AND THEIR

        TRANSACTION NOR ANY INFORMATION CONTAINED ON THIS WEBSITE CONSTITUTE AN
        OFFER (‘OFERTA’) PURSUANT TO RUSSIAN LAW, OR AN ADVERTISEMENT, OR AN

import { FC, memo } from "react";
import { Link, useLoaderData } from "react-router-dom";

import { ILoadedData } from "./../../../entities/types";
import { useLangData } from "../../../entities/lang/lang.selectors";

import { isRuText } from "../../../scripts/helpers";

import PageContainer from "../../PageContainer";

import Headline from "./../../../components/Headline";
import ColumnsList from "./../../../components/ColumnsList";
import SectionWithWrapper from "./../../../components/SectionWithWrapper";

import { TITLE } from "./store";

import styles from "./Documents.module.sass";

const Documents: FC = () => {
  const { documents } = useLoaderData() as ILoadedData;
  const { lang } = useLangData();

  const currLangItems = documents.filter(el =>
    lang === "en" ? !isRuText(el?.name) : isRuText(el?.name),
  );

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      {!!currLangItems?.length ? (
        <SectionWithWrapper>
          <Headline className={styles.headline} size="h1" tag="h1">
            {TITLE[lang]}
          </Headline>

          <div className={styles.documentsContent}>
            {currLangItems.map((el, index) => {
              const items = el?.children.map(children => ({
                listItemUrl: `/documents/${el.contractorName}/${children.contractorName}/`,
                listItemName: children.name,
              }));

              return (
                <div key={index}>
                  {el.name && (
                    <Link to={`/documents/${el.contractorName}`}>
                      <Headline className={styles.subtitle} size="h4" tag="h1">
                        {el.name}
                      </Headline>
                    </Link>
                  )}
                  {items?.length && <ColumnsList items={items} />}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </SectionWithWrapper>
      ) : null}
    </PageContainer>
  );
};

export default memo(Documents);

import { FC, memo } from "react";
import { useLoaderData } from "react-router-dom";

import { ILoadedData } from "./../../../entities/types";

import PageContainer from "../../PageContainer";

import Headline from "./../../../components/Headline";
import ColumnsList from "./../../../components/ColumnsList";
import SectionWithWrapper from "./../../../components/SectionWithWrapper";
import ReturnLink from "../../../components/ReturnLink";

import { useLangData } from "../../../entities/lang/lang.selectors";

import styles from "./DocumentsSection.module.sass";

import { RETURN_LINK_TITLE, SUBTITLES } from "./store";

const DocumentsSection: FC = () => {
  const { documents } = useLoaderData() as ILoadedData;
  const { lang } = useLangData();

  const items = documents[0]?.children.map(children => ({
    listItemUrl: `/documents/${documents[0].contractorName}/${children.contractorName}/`,
    listItemName: children?.name || "",
  }));

  const subtitle = SUBTITLES(documents[0]?.contractorName);

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      {!!documents?.length ? (
        <SectionWithWrapper>
          <ReturnLink title={RETURN_LINK_TITLE[lang]} link="/" />
          {documents[0]?.name && (
            <Headline className={styles.headline} size="h1" tag="h1">
              {documents[0].name}
            </Headline>
          )}
          <div className={styles.subtitle}>{subtitle && subtitle}</div>
          <div className={styles.documentsContent}>
            {items?.length && <ColumnsList items={items} columns={1} />}
          </div>
        </SectionWithWrapper>
      ) : null}
    </PageContainer>
  );
};

export default memo(DocumentsSection);

--- FILE: src/containers/ProductPages/EquitiesCalculator/EquitiesCalculator.tsx ---
import { FC, memo, useState } from "react";
import { useLoaderData } from "react-router-dom";
import cn from "classnames";

import { compareToLowerCase, formatCurrency } from "./../../../scripts/helpers";
import useOutsideClick from "./../../../scripts/useOutsideClick";

import { ILoadedData } from "./../../../entities/types";
import { useLangData } from "../../../entities/lang/lang.selectors";

import PageContainer from "../../PageContainer";

import Button from "../../../components/Button";
import Headline from "./../../../components/Headline";
import Input from "../../../components/Input";
import InstrumentIcon from "../../../components/InstrumentIcon";
import Search from "./../../../components/Search";
import SectionWithWrapper from "./../../../components/SectionWithWrapper";
import Text from "./../../../components/Text";

import SearchList from "./partials/SearchList";

import { TITLE, SUBTITLE } from "./store";

import styles from "./EquitiesCalculator.module.sass";

interface ISearchItem {
  price: number;
  value: number;
}

const EquitiesCalculator: FC = () => {
  const { equities } = useLoaderData() as ILoadedData;
  const { lang } = useLangData();
  const { ref, isActive, setIsActive } = useOutsideClick(false, ["search"]);

  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [addedEquities, setAddedEquities] = useState([]);
  const [addedEquitiesValue, setAddedEquitiesValue] = useState({});

  const searchEquities = equities.filter(
    el =>
      (search.length > 2 &&
        (compareToLowerCase(el.issuer, search) ||
          compareToLowerCase(el.isin, search))) ||
      compareToLowerCase(el.ticker, search, true),
  );

  const itemClickHandler = el => {
    setAddedEquities([...addedEquities, el]);
    setAddedEquitiesValueHandler(0, el);
    setIsActive(false);
    setSearch("");
  };

  const setAddedEquitiesValueHandler = (value, el) => {
    const newAddedEquitiesValue = {
      ...addedEquitiesValue,
      [el.isin]: { value, price: el.price },
    };
    setAddedEquitiesValue(newAddedEquitiesValue);
  };

  const sum = () => {
    let summ = 0;
    Object.values(addedEquitiesValue).forEach((el: ISearchItem) => {
      summ = summ + el.value * el.price;
    });
    return summ;
  };

  const onClear = () => {
    setAddedEquities([]);
    setAddedEquitiesValue({});
  };

  const deleteFromAdded = (el, index) => {
    const newAddedEquities = [...addedEquities];
    newAddedEquities.splice(index, 1);

    const newAddedEquitiesValue = {
      ...addedEquitiesValue,
    };
    delete newAddedEquitiesValue[el.isin];

    setAddedEquities(newAddedEquities);
    setAddedEquitiesValue(newAddedEquitiesValue);
  };

  const summError = sum() > 100000;

  return (
    <PageContainer>
      <SectionWithWrapper
        wrapperProps={{ className: styles.equitiesCalculator }}
      >
        <Headline className={styles.headline} size="h1" tag="h1">
          {TITLE[lang]}
        </Headline>

        <Text className={styles.subtitle} tag="p" size="l" fontVariant="regular">
          {SUBTITLE[lang]}
        </Text>

        <Search
          className={styles.input}
          label={"Найти по тикеру, ISIN или названию"}
          onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          onFocus={() => {
            setIsActive(true);
          }}
          id="search"
          onClear={() => setSearch("")}
          value={search}
          showClearBtn={!!search.length}
        />

        {search.length > 0 && isActive && (
          <div ref={ref}>
            <SearchList
              searchEquities={searchEquities}
              addedEquities={addedEquities}
              itemClickHandler={itemClickHandler}
              isNotFound={search.length > 0 && !searchEquities?.length}
              notFoundText="По данному запросу ничего не найдено"
            />
          </div>
        )}

        <div className={styles.addedEquities}>
          {!!addedEquities?.length &&
            addedEquities.map((el, index) => (
              <div className={styles.addedEquitiesItem} key={el.isin}>
                <div className={styles.addedEquitiesInfo}>
                  <InstrumentIcon
                    instrumentImageName={el.instrumentImageName}
                    className={styles.icon}
                  />
                  <div className={styles.addedEquitiesItemInfo}>
                    <span className={styles.addedEquitiesItemTitle}>
                      {el.issuer}
                    </span>
                    <span className={styles.addedEquitiesItemOther}>
                      {el.ticker} • {el.isin}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <Input
                  type="number"
                  className={styles.addedEquitiesInput}
                  label={"Количество (шт.)"}
                  value={addedEquitiesValue[el.isin]?.value}
                  onChange={e =>
                    setAddedEquitiesValueHandler(e.target.value, el)
                  }
                  onBlur={e =>
                    e.target.value === "" && setAddedEquitiesValueHandler(0, el)
                  }
                  withButtons
                />
                <div className={styles.addedEquitiesItemPrice}>
                  <span className={styles.addedEquitiesItemTitle}>
                    Цена за 1 шт.
                  </span>
                  <span className={styles.addedEquitiesItemOther}>
                    {formatCurrency(el.price, 6)} ₽
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className={styles.addedEquitiesItemSum}>
                  <span className={styles.addedEquitiesItemTitle}>Сумма</span>
                  <span className={styles.addedEquitiesItemOther}>
                    {formatCurrency(
                      el.price * addedEquitiesValue[el.isin]?.value,
                    )}{" "}
                    ₽
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div
                  className={styles.deleteBtn}
                  onClick={() => deleteFromAdded(el, index)}
                />
              </div>
            ))}
        </div>

        {!!addedEquities?.length && (
          <div className={styles.results}>
            <Button
              className={styles.button}
              onClick={onClear}
              title={"Очистить"}
              theme="accent"
            />
            <div
              className={cn(styles.calculatorSumm, {
                [styles.calculatorSummError]: summError,
              })}
            >
              <span className={styles.title}>
                Объём поручения (не более 100 000 ₽)
              </span>
              <span className={styles.summ}>{formatCurrency(sum())} ₽</span>
              {summError && (
                <span className={styles.errorText}>
                  Общая сумма не должна превышать 100 000 ₽
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </SectionWithWrapper>
    </PageContainer>
  );
};

export default memo(EquitiesCalculator);

import { FC, memo } from "react";

import cn from "classnames";

import InstrumentIcon from "./../../../../../components/InstrumentIcon";
import Text from "./../../../../../components/Text";

import { formatCurrency } from "../../../../../scripts/helpers";

import styles from "./SearchList.module.sass";

import { ISearchList } from "./types";

const SearchList: FC<ISearchList> = ({
  addedEquities,
  itemClickHandler,
  isNotFound,
  notFoundText,
  searchEquities,
}) => {
  return (
    <div className={styles.searchEquitiesList}>
      {isNotFound ? (
        <Text className={styles.notFound} color="gray" size="s">
          {notFoundText}
        </Text>
      ) : (
        searchEquities.map(el => {
          const isAdded = addedEquities.find(added => added.isin === el.isin);
          return (
            <div
              key={el.isin}
              className={cn(styles.searchEquitiesItem, {
                [styles.addedEquity]: isAdded,
              })}
              onClick={() => itemClickHandler(el)}
            >
              <InstrumentIcon
                instrumentImageName={el.instrumentImageName}
                className={styles.icon}
              />

              <div className={styles.searchEquitiesItemInfo}>
                <span className={styles.searchEquitiesItemTitle}>
                  {el.issuer}
                </span>
                <span className={styles.searchEquitiesItemOther}>
                  {el.ticker} • {el.isin} • {formatCurrency(el.price, 6)}₽
                </span>
                <span className={styles.addedText}>
                  {!!isAdded && (
                    <>
                      <span className={styles.addedTextDesktop}>
                        добавлено в список
                      </span>
                      <span className={styles.addedTextMobile}>&#10004;</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default memo(SearchList);

import { FC, memo, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useDispatch } from "react-redux";

import PageContainer from "./../../PageContainer";
import Headline from "../../../components/Headline";
import SectionWithWrapper from "../../../components/SectionWithWrapper";
import StepSmsCode from "./partials/StepSmsCode";
import StepLoginPwd from "./partials/StepLoginPwd";

import { setInitialStateOtp } from "../../../entities/otp/otp.slice";
import { setCaptchaRequired, setInitialState } from "../../../entities/auth/auth.slice";
import { setInitialState as setTransferInitialState } from "../../../entities/transfer/transfer.slice";

import { DEFAULT_REDIRECT_ROUTE, PAGE_TITLE, TITLE } from "./store";

import styles from "./Login.module.sass";

const Login: FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();

  const [step, setStep] = useState("form");

  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = PAGE_TITLE;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    dispatch(setInitialStateOtp());
    dispatch(setInitialState());
  }, [dispatch]);

  const onConfirmCode = useCallback((data) => {
    if (data?.Session) {
      dispatch(setInitialStateOtp());
      dispatch(setTransferInitialState());
      return navigate(DEFAULT_REDIRECT_ROUTE);
    }
  }, [dispatch, navigate]);

  const onBackClick = useCallback(() => {
    dispatch(setCaptchaRequired(false));
    setStep("form");
  }, [dispatch]);

  const onLoginSuccess = useCallback(() => setStep("sms"), []);

  return (
    <PageContainer withoutHeader>
      <SectionWithWrapper
        sectionProps={{
          paddingTop: "m",
        }}
        wrapperProps={{ className: styles.login }}
      >
        <Headline className={styles.headline} size="h1" tag="h2">
          {TITLE}
        </Headline>
        
        {step === "form" && (
          <StepLoginPwd
            onSuccess={onLoginSuccess}
          />
        )}

        {step === "sms" && (
          <StepSmsCode
            onConfirm={onConfirmCode}
            onBack={onBackClick}
          />
        )}
      </SectionWithWrapper>
    </PageContainer>
  );
};

export default memo(Login);

--- FILE: src/containers/ProductPages/Login/partials/StepLoginPwd/StepLoginPwd.tsx ---
import { ChangeEvent, FC, memo, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";

import Button from "../../../../../components/Button";
import Input from "../../../../../components/Input";
import InputPassword from "../../../../../components/InputPassword";

import { login } from "../../../../../entities/auth/requests";
import { useAuth } from "../../../../../entities/auth/auth.selectors";
import { setError, setInitialState } from "../../../../../entities/auth/auth.slice";

import { FIELDS, BUTTON_LOGIN_VALUE, INFO, BUTTON_LOGIN_LOADING, BUTTON_RESET_ACCESS } from "./store";
import { useAppDispatch } from "../../../../../store";
import { API_CAPTCHA, API_SESSIONS_EMPLOYEE } from "../../../../../constants/API";
import { DEFAULT_REDIRECT_ROUTE } from "../../store";
import { sendPostRequest } from "../../../../../scripts/requests";

import { ReactComponent as RenewIcon } from "../../../../../icons/renew-icon.svg";
import { ReactComponent as ShieldIcon } from "../../../../../icons/shield-icon.svg";

import styles from "./StepLoginPwd.module.sass";

import { IStepLoginPwdProps } from "./types";
import { ROUTE_RESTORE_PASSWORD } from "../../../../../constants/routes";


const StepLoginPwd: FC<IStepLoginPwdProps> = ({ onSuccess }) => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();

  const { error, captchaRequired, loading } = useAuth();

  const [loginValue, setLogin] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [captcha, setCaptcha] = useState("");
  const [captchaHash, setCaptchaHash] = useState(Date.now());
  const [personalDataConsent, setPersonalDataConsent] = useState(false);
  const [tokenLoading, setTokenLoading] = useState(false);


  useEffect(() => {
    const token = searchParams.get('token');
    if (token && !tokenLoading) {
      setTokenLoading(true);
      sendPostRequest({
        api: API_SESSIONS_EMPLOYEE,
        body: { sessionToken: token },
        callback: (data) => {
          setTokenLoading(false);
          if (data?.Success) {
            navigate(DEFAULT_REDIRECT_ROUTE);
          }
        },
      });
    }
  }, [navigate, searchParams, tokenLoading]);

  const refreshCaptcha = useCallback(() => {
    setCaptcha("");
    setCaptchaHash(Date.now);
  }, []);

  const loginHandler = () => {
    const loginCb = () => onSuccess?.();

    dispatch(login({
      login: loginValue,
      password,
      captcha,
      successCallback: loginCb,
      errorCallback: refreshCaptcha,
    }));
  };


  const onPersonalDataConsentChange = useCallback((e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setPersonalDataConsent(e.target.checked);
  }, []);

  const registrationHandler = () => {
    if (process.env.ENV === "tt") {
      window.open(
        'https://newlk-tt.investpalata.ru/registration?service=obmen',
        '_blank'
      );
    } else {
      window.open(
        'https://lk.investpalata.ru/registration?service=obmen',
        '_blank'
      );
    }

  };

  const onLoginChange = useCallback((e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setLogin(e.target.value);
    if (e.target.value !== loginValue) dispatch(setError(null));
  }, [dispatch, loginValue]);

  const onPwdChange = useCallback((e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setPassword(e.target.value);
    if (e.target.value !== password) dispatch(setError(null));
  }, [dispatch, password]);

  const onCaptchaChange = useCallback((e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setCaptcha(e.target.value);
  }, []);

  const onResetPwdClick = useCallback(() => {
    dispatch(setInitialState());
    navigate(ROUTE_RESTORE_PASSWORD)
  }, [dispatch, navigate]);

  const buttonDisabled = !(loginValue && password && personalDataConsent) || loading === "pending";


  if (tokenLoading) {
    return <div className={styles.loader}>Загрузка...</div>;
  }
  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.title}>введите логин и пароль для входа в систему ЭДО</div>
      <Input
        className={styles.input}
        label={FIELDS.login.label}
        onChange={onLoginChange}
      />
      <InputPassword
        className={styles.input}
        label={FIELDS.password.label}
        onChange={onPwdChange}
      />

      {captchaRequired && (
        <div className={styles.captchaContainer}>
          <div className={styles.captchaWrapper}>
            <img
              alt="captcha"
              className={styles.captcha}
              src={API_CAPTCHA + "?hash=" + captchaHash}
            />
            <span
              onClick={refreshCaptcha}
              className={styles.captchaRefresh}
            >
              <RenewIcon />
              Обновить изображение
            </span>
          </div>
          <Input
            className={styles.input}
            classNameInput={styles.inputCaptcha}
            placeholder={FIELDS.captcha.label}
            onChange={onCaptchaChange}
            value={captcha}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {error && <span className={styles.error}>{error?.ErrorMessageText || error}</span>}


      <div className={styles.noLoginBlock}
        onClick={registrationHandler}
      >
        <div className={styles.noLoginIcon}>
          <ShieldIcon />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.noLoginContent}>
          <h3 className={styles.noLoginTitle}>У меня нет логина и пароля</h3>
        </div>
      </div>

      <label className={styles.checkboxContainer}>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          checked={personalDataConsent}
          onChange={onPersonalDataConsentChange}
          className={styles.checkbox}
        />
        <span className={styles.checkboxLabel}>
          <a href="https://s3.investpalata.ru/lp/personal-data-consent.pdf" className={styles.link} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Согласие на обработку персональных данных ООО "Инвестиционная палата"</a>.
          Подробнее об обработке данных в {" "}
          <a href="https://s3.investpalata.ru/lp/Политика конфиденциальности _ политика в отношении обработки ПДн (ред. 21.11.2025)(v4) (3).pdf" className={styles.link} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
            Политике
          </a>
          .
        </span>
      </label>

      <div className={`${styles.title} ${styles.titleLogPwd}`}>
        Нажимая «Войти» я подтверждаю заключение с ООО «Инвестиционная палата»{' '}
        <a href="https://s3.investpalata.ru/lp/edo_pep.pdf" className={styles.link}>
          Соглашения об использовании системы ЭДО и электронной подписи
        </a>
      </div>

      <div className={styles.buttons}>
        <Button
          disabled={buttonDisabled}
          className={styles.button}
          onClick={loginHandler}
          title={loading === "pending" ? BUTTON_LOGIN_LOADING : BUTTON_LOGIN_VALUE}
          theme="accent"
        />
        <Button
          className={styles.button}
          title={BUTTON_RESET_ACCESS}
          theme="light"
          onClick={onResetPwdClick}
        />
      </div>

      <span className={styles.info}>
        {INFO}
        <br />
        <div className={`${styles.restoreAgreement}`}>
          В случае возникновения ошибок в процессе взаимодействия с системой ЭДО просим обращаться на адрес электронной почты <a className={styles.link} rel="noopener noreferrer" href="mailto:clients_support@investpalata.ru">clients_support@investpalata.ru</a> для проверки специалистами Ваших анкетных данных.
        </div>
      </span>

    </>
  )
}

export default memo(StepLoginPwd);

import { FC, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useDispatch } from "react-redux";

import Button from "../../../../../components/Button";
import Input from "../../../../../components/Input";

import { useOTPData } from "../../../../../entities/otp/otp.selectors";
import { errorOTP, saveSms } from "../../../../../entities/otp/otp.slice";
import { useAuth } from "../../../../../entities/auth/auth.selectors";
import { otpConfirm, otpRenew } from "../../../../../entities/auth/requests";

import { IStepSmsCodeProps } from "./types";
import {
    BUTTON_SMS_CANCEL,
    BUTTON_SMS_LOADING,
    BUTTON_SMS_VALUE,
    RENEW_SMS_TEXT,
    SMS_FIELD_LABEL,
} from "./store";
import { ERROR_TEXT_CODES } from "../../../../../utils/mobileAppNotificator";

import { ReactComponent as RenewIcon } from "./../../../../../icons/renew-icon.svg";
import styles from "./StepSmsCode.module.sass";

const StepSmsCode: FC<IStepSmsCodeProps> = ({ onConfirm, onBack }) => {
    const { otp, otpError, otpErrorCode, otpTryCount, sms } = useOTPData();
    const { loading } = useAuth();

    const intervalRef = useRef(null);

    const [smsSended, setSmsSended] = useState(false);
    const [timer, setTimer] = useState(0);
    const [resendSms, setResendSms] = useState(false);
    const [smsDisabled, setSmsDisabled] = useState(false);

    const dispatch = useDispatch();

    const isSMSTryCountExceeded = otpErrorCode === ERROR_TEXT_CODES.SMS_TRY_COUNT_EXCEEDED;
    const isSmsConfirmationFailed = otpErrorCode === ERROR_TEXT_CODES.SMS_CODE_CONFIRMATION_FAILED;
    const isSmsLifeTimeExpired = otpErrorCode === ERROR_TEXT_CODES.SMS_LIFE_TIME_EXPIRED;

    const btnSendDisabled = isSMSTryCountExceeded || isSmsLifeTimeExpired || !sms || loading === "pending";

    const setTick = useCallback((timer) => {
        if (timer > 0) {
            intervalRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
                setTimer(timer - 1);
                setTick(timer - 1);
            }, 1000);
        } else {
            setTimer(60);
            setResendSms(true);
        }
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (otp?.phone) {
            setTick(otp?.timeout);
            setSmsSended(true);
            setSmsDisabled(false);
        }
    }, [otp, setTick])

    const stop = useCallback(() => {
        clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
        intervalRef.current = null;
    }, []);

    const smsInputHandler = e => {
        const value = e.target.value;
        if (value !== sms) {
            dispatch(saveSms(value));
            if (otpError) {
                dispatch(errorOTP({ otpError: null, otpErrorCode: null }));
            }
        }
    };

    const onSendSmsClick = () => {
        if (otp?.operationId) {
            otpConfirm({ otp, sms, callback: onConfirm });
        }
    };

    const submitSmsHandlerRenew = () => {
        setResendSms(false);
        stop();

        const verifyCb = data => {
            setSmsDisabled(false);
            setSmsSended(true);
            setTick(data?.timeout);
        };

        otpRenew({ operationId: otp.operationId, callback: verifyCb });
    };

    const smsInputError = otpError
        ? `${otpError}${isSmsConfirmationFailed
            ? `. Осталось попыток: ${otpTryCount}`
            : ""}`
        : "";

    return (
        <>
            {smsSended && otp?.phone &&
                <span className={styles.crcSubtitle}>
                    Для продолжения и заключения Соглашения об использовании системы ЭДО и электронной подписи ООО «Инвестиционная палата» введите код подтверждения из SMS
                    <br />
                    {`Отправлен на номер ${otp.phone}`}
                </span>
            }
            <Input
                value={sms}
                className={styles.input}
                label={SMS_FIELD_LABEL}
                onChange={smsInputHandler}
                error={smsInputError && <span dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: smsInputError }} />}
                disabled={smsDisabled}
            />

            {smsSended && (
                <>
                    {resendSms ? (
                        <span
                            className={styles.crcSubtitleRenew}
                            onClick={submitSmsHandlerRenew}
                        >
                            <RenewIcon />
                            {RENEW_SMS_TEXT}
                        </span>
                    ) : (
                        <span className={styles.crcSubtitle}>
                            {`Вы можете запросить новый код через ${timer} сек.`}
                            <br />
                            Среднее время доставки SMS - около 2 минут
                            <br />
                            Срок действия кода - 5 минут
                        </span>
                    )}
                </>
            )}

            <div className={styles.smsButtons}>
                <Button
                    disabled={btnSendDisabled}
                    className={styles.button}
                    onClick={onSendSmsClick}
                    title={loading === "pending" ? BUTTON_SMS_LOADING : BUTTON_SMS_VALUE}
                    theme="accent"
                    type="submit"
                />
                <Button
                    className={styles.button}
                    title={BUTTON_SMS_CANCEL}
                    theme="light"
                    onClick={onBack}
                />
            </div>
        </>
    )
}

export default StepSmsCode;

import { FC, memo } from "react";
import { useLoaderData } from "react-router-dom";

import { useLangData } from "../../../../../entities/lang/lang.selectors";
import { ILoadedData } from "../../../../../entities/types";
import { isRuText } from "./../../../../../scripts/helpers";

import Accordion from "./../../../../../components/Accordion";
import Headline from "../../../../../components/Headline";
import SectionWithWrapper from "../../../../../components/SectionWithWrapper";
import Text from "./../../../../../components/Text";
import Tabs from "./../../../../../components/Tabs";

import styles from "./FAQSection.module.sass";

import { TITLE, DESCRIPTION, TEXT_AFTER } from "./store";

const FAQSection: FC = () => {
  const { faq } = useLoaderData() as ILoadedData;
  const { lang } = useLangData();

  const getCurrLangItems = items => {
    return (
      items.filter(el =>
        lang === "en" ? !isRuText(el.title) : isRuText(el.title),
      ) || []
    );
  };

  const getTabs = items => {
    return getCurrLangItems(items).map(item => ({
      label: item.title,
      content: item.children.map(children => (
        <Accordion
          key={children.id}
          title={children.title}
          content={children.content}
        />
      )),
    }));
  };

  return !!faq.length ? (
    <SectionWithWrapper sectionProps={{ id: "faq" }}>
      <Headline className={styles.headline} size="h1" tag="h2">
        {TITLE[lang]}
      </Headline>

      <Text className={styles.text} size="l" color="gray">
        {DESCRIPTION[lang]}
      </Text>

      <Tabs items={getTabs(faq)} />

      <Text className={styles.textAfter} size="l" color="gray">
        {TEXT_AFTER[lang]}
      </Text>
    </SectionWithWrapper>
  ) : null;
};

export default memo(FAQSection);

import { FC, memo } from "react";
import { Link, useLoaderData } from "react-router-dom";
import Button from "../../../../../components/Button";
import { useLangData } from "../../../../../entities/lang/lang.selectors";

import { ILoadedData } from "../../../../../entities/types";
import { formatDate } from "../../../../../scripts/helpers";

import Headline from "./../../../../../components/Headline";
import SectionWithWrapper from "./../../../../../components/SectionWithWrapper";
import Text from "./../../../../../components/Text";

import styles from "./NewsSection.module.sass";

import { TITLE } from "./store";

const NewsSection: FC = () => {
  const { news } = useLoaderData() as ILoadedData;
  const { lang } = useLangData();

  const currLangNews = news?.items?.filter(el => {
    return lang === "en"
      ? el.tagNames.includes("eng")
      : !el.tagNames.includes("eng");
  });

  return !!news?.items.length ? (
    <SectionWithWrapper>
      <Headline className={styles.headline} size="h1" tag="h2">
        {TITLE[lang]}
      </Headline>

      {currLangNews.splice(0, 3).map(el => (
        <Link
          to={`/news/article/${el.id}`}
          key={el.id}
          className={styles.newsRow}
        >
          <Text className={styles.newsRowDate} color="gray" size="s">
            {formatDate(el.date, lang)}
          </Text>
          <Text className={styles.newsRowTitle} size="l" fontVariant="medium">
            {el.title}
          </Text>
        </Link>
      ))}

      <Button
        className={styles.button}
        title={lang === "en" ? "View all" : "Посмотреть все"}
        link="/news/"
        theme="outlined"
      />
    </SectionWithWrapper>
  ) : null;
};

export default memo(NewsSection);

import { GENERAL_TRADE_URL } from "../../../../../constants/urls";
import { formatString } from "./../../../../../scripts/formatString";

export const TITLE = {
  ru: formatString(
    "ВЫКУП ИНОСТРАННЫХ ЦЕННЫХ БУМАГ У РОССИЙСКИХ ЧАСТНЫХ ИНВЕСТОРОВ",
  ),
  en: "Purchase of foreign securities from Russian private investors",
};

export const TEXT = {
  ru: (
    <>
      <p>
        <a href="http://publication.pravo.gov.ru/document/0001202311080023">
          Указ Президента РФ от 8 ноября 2023 года № 844
        </a>{" "}
        создал условия для того, чтобы российские частные инвесторы-резиденты
        смогли продать заблокированные иностранные ценные бумаги (ИЦБ)
        нерезидентам. 2 февраля 2024 года Правительственная комиссия по контролю
        за осуществлением иностранных инвестиций в РФ утвердила ключевые условия
        выкупа иностранных ценных бумаг, а также{" "}
        <a
          href={`${GENERAL_TRADE_URL}documents/usloviya-i-dokumenty/usloviya-provedeniya-torgov-i-soversheniya-sdelok-operaciy-s-inostrannymi-cennymi-bumagami/`}
        >
          установила
        </a>
        , что организатором торгов будет ООО "Инвестиционная Палата".
      </p>
      <p>
        Российские частные инвесторы-резиденты имеют право продать ИЦБ –
        зарубежные акции, депозитарные расписки на зарубежные акции,
        инвестиционные паи, в составе которых есть зарубежные акции – на сумму
        до 100 000 рублей. Такие условия позволяют участвовать в выкупе как
        можно большему числу граждан.
      </p>
      <p>
        Подать заявки частные инвесторы-резиденты могут через своих брокеров,
        доверительных управляющих и управляющих компаний паевых инвестиционных
        фондов (ПИФ) с 25 марта 2024 года. Финальная цена выкупа ИЦБ определится
        по итогам отбора заявок от нерезидентов, но в любом случае она будет не
        ниже стоимости актива в рублях на закрытие торгов 22 марта 2024 года.
      </p>
      <p>
        В результате сделки российские частные инвесторы-резиденты смогут
        продать ИЦБ, заблокированные на счетах российского центрального
        депозитария (НРД), а нерезиденты – приобрести эти бумаги за рубли, в том
        числе за счет их денежных средств, находящихся на счетах типа «С».
      </p>
      <br />
      <p>
        <b>Основные этапы сделки</b>
      </p>
      <p>
        1. Организатор торгов собирает оферты на продажу заблокированных ИЦБ от
        российских частных инвесторов-резидентов через их брокеров,
        доверительных управляющих и управляющие компании ПИФов.
      </p>
      <p>
        2. Организатор торгов делит общий пул этих бумаг на лоты, максимально
        идентичные по наполнению и совокупной стоимости ИЦБ. После
        устанавливается единая для всех лотов стартовая ставка, которая не может
        быть меньше средней стоимости входящих в каждый лот бумаг.
      </p>
      <p>
        3. Организатор торгов собирает заявки нерезидентов на покупку
        сформированных лотов. Заявки, в которых предложенная цена ниже стартовой
        ставки, будут отклонены.
      </p>
      <p>
        4. Организатор торгов в результате отбора заявок нерезидентов определит
        для всех лотов единую финальную цену продажи, которая будет не ниже
        стартовой ставки. Следовательно, и финальная цена продажи каждой ИЦБ
        будет не ниже цены, определенной на закрытие торгов 22 марта 2024 года и
        выраженной в рублях по курсу Банка России на ту же дату.
      </p>
      <br />
      <p>
        После этого заключаются сделки: российские частные инвесторы-резиденты
        получают денежные средства нерезидентов, а нерезиденты – ценные бумаги.
        ИЦБ российских резидентов, чьи оферты не были удовлетворены или были
        удовлетворены частично, не списываются со счетов депо владельцев, а
        незадействованные деньги нерезидентов возвращаются на их рублевые счета,
        включая счета типа «С».
      </p>
      <p>
        Полный перечень ИЦБ, которые можно предъявить к выкупу, можно найти в
        разделе{" "}
        <a
          href={`${GENERAL_TRADE_URL}documents/perechen-inostrannyh-cennyh-bumag/`}
        >
          «Перечень иностранных ценных бумаг»
        </a>
        . Больше информации о выкупе и ответы на часто задаваемые вопросы – в
        разделах <a href={`${GENERAL_TRADE_URL}news/`}>«Пресс-релизы»</a>,
        <a href={`${GENERAL_TRADE_URL}#faq`}>«Часто задаваемые вопросы»</a>, а
        также в презентациях для резидентов и участников торгов.
      </p>
      <p>
        Вся информация, обязательная к раскрытию Организатором торгов в процессе
        выкупа и совершения сделок (операций), будет размещаться в разделе
        <a
          href={`${GENERAL_TRADE_URL}documents/raskrytie-informacii-organizatorom-torgov/`}
        >
          «Раскрытие информации организатором торгов»
        </a>
        .
      </p>
    </>
  ),
  en: (
    <>
      <p>
        Russian Presidential Decree No. 844, adopted on 8 November 2023,
        introduced a framework, which enabled Russian private investors to sell
        blocked foreign securities (“FS”) to non-residents. On 2 February 2024,
        the Government Commission for Control Over Foreign Investment in the
        Russian Federation approved the key terms for the sale of foreign assets
        and appointed Investitsionnaya Palata as the transaction organiser.
      </p>
      <p>
        Russian private investors have the right to sell FS (foreign shares,
        depositary receipts on foreign shares, and investment units that include
        foreign shares) with an initial starting value of up to RUB 100,000.
        This will enable maximum participation in the purchase transaction.
      </p>
      <p>
        Private investors can submit offers through their brokers, trust
        managers and mutual fund managers starting from 25 March 2024. The final
        purchase price of the FS will be determined based on a selection of bids
        received from non-residents, but will not be lower than the market price
        of the FS in roubles as of close of trading on 22 March 2024.
      </p>
      <p>
        The purchase transaction will enable Russian private investors to sell
        their FS, which have been blocked in accounts of the Russian central
        securities depository (NSD), while non-residents will be able to
        purchase the securities for roubles, including those held on “S”-type
        accounts.
      </p>
      <br />
      <p>
        <b>Key stages of the purchase transaction</b>
      </p>
      <p>
        1. The transaction organiser collects applications to sell blocked FS
        from Russian private investors through their brokers, trust managers and
        mutual fund managers.
      </p>
      <p>
        2. The transaction organiser will form a pool of securities and divide
        it into lots, which will be as identical as possible in terms of their
        composition and the aggregate value of the FS. The same starting bid is
        then set for all the lots, which cannot be less than the average value
        of all the lots.
      </p>
      <p>
        3. The transaction organiser collects bids for the lots from
        non-residents. Any bids lower than the starting bid will be rejected.
      </p>
      <p>
        4. Upon the result of a competitive selection of bids from
        non-residents, the transaction organiser determines the same final
        selling price for all the lots, which will not be lower than the
        starting bid. Consequently, the final selling price of each FS will not
        be lower than the market price determined at the close of trading on 22
        March 2024 and expressed in roubles at the exchange rate of the Central
        Bank of Russia on the same date.
      </p>
      <p>
        Afterwards, the settlement will take place: Russian private investors
        will receive funds from non-residents, and non-residents will receive
        FS. FS of Russian private investors whose offers were not accepted or
        were only partially accepted will not be written off from their owners’
        accounts, while unused funds of non-residents will be returned to their
        rouble accounts, including “S”-type accounts.
      </p>
      <p>
        A full list of the FS eligible for purchase can be found in the section
        <a
          href={`${GENERAL_TRADE_URL}documents/list-of-securities-to-be-redeemed/the-list-of-foreign-securities-eligible-for-the-purchase-transaction/`}
        >
          “List of eligible securities”
        </a>
        . More information about the purchase transaction and answers to key
        questions can be found in the sections{" "}
        <a href={`${GENERAL_TRADE_URL}news/`}>“Press-releases”</a> and{" "}
        <a href={`${GENERAL_TRADE_URL}#faq`}>
          “Frequently asked questions (FAQ)”
        </a>
        , as well as in the presentations for private investors and professional
        securities market participants.
      </p>
    </>
  ),
};

import { FC, memo } from "react";
import { Link, useLoaderData } from "react-router-dom";

import PageContainer from "./../../PageContainer";

import Headline from "./../../../components/Headline";
import ReturnLink from "./../../../components/ReturnLink";
import SectionWithWrapper from "./../../../components/SectionWithWrapper";
import Text from "./../../../components/Text";

import { formatDate, isRuText } from "../../../scripts/helpers";

import { ILoadedData } from "../../../entities/types";
import { useLangData } from "../../../entities/lang/lang.selectors";

import { TITLE, MAIN_LINK_TEXT } from "./store";

import styles from "./News.module.sass";

const News: FC = () => {
  const { news } = useLoaderData() as ILoadedData;
  const { lang } = useLangData();

  const currLangNews = news?.items?.filter(el =>
    lang === "en" ? !isRuText(el.title) : isRuText(el.title),
  );

  return news?.items ? (
    <div className={styles.news}>
      <PageContainer>
        <SectionWithWrapper>
          <ReturnLink title={MAIN_LINK_TEXT[lang]} link="/" />

          <Headline size="h1" tag="h1" className={styles.headline}>
            {TITLE[lang]}
          </Headline>

          {currLangNews.map(el => (
            <Link
              to={`/news/article/${el.id}`}
              key={el.id}
              className={styles.newsRow}
            >
              <Text className={styles.newsRowDate} color="gray" size="s">
                {formatDate(el.date, lang)}
              </Text>
              <Text
                className={styles.newsRowTitle}
                size="l"
                fontVariant="medium"
              >
                {el.title}
              </Text>
            </Link>
          ))}
        </SectionWithWrapper>
      </PageContainer>
    </div>
  ) : null;
};

export default memo(News);

--- FILE: src/containers/ProductPages/PageNewPassword/PageNewPassword.tsx ---
import React, { FC, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import md5 from 'crypto-js/md5';
import cn from "classnames";

import Button from '../../../components/Button';
import Headline from '../../../components/Headline';
import PageContainer from '../../PageContainer';
import SectionWithWrapper from '../../../components/SectionWithWrapper';
import InputNewPassword from '../../../components/InputNewPassword';
import InputPassword from '../../../components/InputPassword';

import { useAuth } from '../../../entities/auth/auth.selectors';
import { useAppDispatch } from '../../../store';
import { createNewPassword, getPasswordPolicies, resetPasswordCheckId } from '../../../entities/auth/requests';
import { setInitialState } from '../../../entities/auth/auth.slice';
import { ROUTE_LOGIN } from '../../../constants/routes';

import styles from './PageNewPassword.module.sass';

interface stateProps {
  value: string;
  status?: string;
  description?: string;
}

interface IPageNewPasswordProps {
  checkId: string
}

const PageNewPassword: FC<IPageNewPasswordProps> = ({ checkId }) => {
  const { passwordPolicies, error, creatingPassword } = useAuth();

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState<stateProps>({
    value: '',
  });
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState<stateProps>({
    value: '',
  });
  const [minReq, setMinReq] = useState<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (checkId) {
      dispatch(setInitialState());
      dispatch(getPasswordPolicies());
      dispatch(resetPasswordCheckId({ check_id: checkId }));
    }
  }, [checkId, dispatch]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (creatingPassword === "success") navigate(ROUTE_LOGIN);
  }, [creatingPassword, navigate]);

  const disable = !(minReq && newPassword.value && newPassword.value === confirmPassword.value);

  const newPasswordOnChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>, minReqMet: boolean) => {
    const { value } = e.target;
    setMinReq(minReqMet);
    if (value) {
      if (confirmPassword.value && value !== confirmPassword.value) {
        setConfirmPassword({
          ...confirmPassword,
          status: 'error',
          description: 'Пожалуйста, убедитесь, что пароли совпадают',
        });
      } else if (confirmPassword.value && value === confirmPassword.value) {
        setConfirmPassword({
          ...confirmPassword,
          status: 'success',
          description: 'Пароль совпадает',
        });
      }
      setNewPassword({ ...newPassword, value: value });
    } else {
      setNewPassword({ ...newPassword, value: value });
      setConfirmPassword({
        ...confirmPassword,
        status: 'error',
        description: 'Пожалуйста, убедитесь, что пароли совпадают',
      });
    }
  };
  const confirmPasswordOnChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const { value } = e.target;
    if (value) {
      setConfirmPassword({ ...confirmPassword, value: value });
      if (value !== newPassword.value) {
        setConfirmPassword({
          ...confirmPassword,
          value: value,
          status: 'error',
          description: 'Пожалуйста, убедитесь, что пароли совпадают',
        });
      } else {
        setConfirmPassword({
          ...confirmPassword,
          value: value,
          status: 'success',
          description: 'Пароль совпадает',
        });
      }
    } else {
      setConfirmPassword({
        ...confirmPassword,
        value: value,
        status: 'error',
        description: 'Пароль не может быть пустым',
      });
    }
  };
  const handleSubmit = (ev?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    ev?.preventDefault();
    const password = md5(newPassword.value).toString().toUpperCase();

    dispatch(createNewPassword({ passwordHash: password }));
  };

  const onCancelResetClick = useCallback(() => navigate(ROUTE_LOGIN), [navigate])

  return (
    <PageContainer withoutHeader>
      <SectionWithWrapper
        sectionProps={{
          paddingTop: "m",
        }}
        wrapperProps={{ className: styles.login }}
      >
        <Headline className={styles.headline} size="h1" tag="h2">
          Придумайте новый пароль
        </Headline>

          <InputNewPassword
            className={styles.input}
            value={newPassword.value}
            onChange={newPasswordOnChange}
            policyProps={passwordPolicies?.[0]}
            label="Пароль"
          />

          {passwordPolicies?.[0]?.Hint && <span className={styles.policyInfo}>{passwordPolicies?.[0]?.Hint}</span>}

          <InputPassword
            className={styles.input}
            value={confirmPassword.value}
            onChange={confirmPasswordOnChange}
            label="Повторите пароль"
          />

          {confirmPassword?.description && (
            <span className={cn(styles.status, [styles[`status--${confirmPassword?.status}`]])}>
              {confirmPassword?.description}
            </span>
          )}

          <div className={styles.buttons}>
            <Button
              disabled={disable}
              className={styles.button}
              onClick={handleSubmit}
              title={creatingPassword === "pending" ? "Отправка..." : "Сменить пароль"}
              theme="accent"
            />
            <Button
              className={styles.button}
              title="Отмена"
              theme="light"
              onClick={onCancelResetClick}
            />
          </div>

          {error && <span className={styles.error}>{error?.ErrorMessageText || error}</span>}

        </SectionWithWrapper>
      </PageContainer>
  );
};

export default PageNewPassword;

import { ChangeEvent, FC, memo, useCallback, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";

import Button from "../../../../../components/Button";
import Input from "../../../../../components/Input";

import { logout, resetPassword } from "../../../../../entities/auth/requests";
import { useAuth } from "../../../../../entities/auth/auth.selectors";
import { setError } from "../../../../../entities/auth/auth.slice";

import { FIELD_LABEL, BUTTON_RESET_VALUE, BUTTON_RESET_LOADING, BUTTON_RESET_CANCEL } from "./store";
import { useAppDispatch } from "../../../../../store";
import { API_CAPTCHA } from "../../../../../constants/API";

import { ReactComponent as RenewIcon } from "../../../../../icons/renew-icon.svg";

import styles from "./StepLogin.module.sass";

import { IStepLoginProps } from "./types";
import { ROUTE_LOGIN } from "../../../../../constants/routes";

const StepLogin: FC<IStepLoginProps> = ({ onSuccess }) => {
  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const { error, loading } = useAuth();

  const [login, setLogin] = useState("");
  const [captcha, setCaptcha] = useState("");
  const [captchaHash, setCaptchaHash] = useState(Date.now());
  const [accessRestoreConsent, setAccessRestoreConsent] = useState(false);

  const onAccessRestoreConsentChange = useCallback((e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setAccessRestoreConsent(e.target.checked);
  }, []);

  const refreshCaptcha = useCallback(() => {
    setCaptcha("");
    setCaptchaHash(Date.now);
  }, []);

  const onConfirmClick = () => {
    dispatch(resetPassword({
      login,
      captcha,
      successCallback: onSuccess,
      errorCallback: refreshCaptcha,
    }));
  };

  const onCancelResetClick = useCallback(() => {
    logout({ callback: () => navigate(ROUTE_LOGIN) });
  }, [navigate]);

  const onLoginChange = useCallback((e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setLogin(e.target.value);
    if (e.target.value !== login) dispatch(setError(null));
  }, [dispatch, login]);

  const onCaptchaChange = useCallback((e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setCaptcha(e.target.value);
  }, []);

  const buttonDisabled = !(login && captcha && accessRestoreConsent) || loading === "pending";

  return (
    <>
      <Input
        className={styles.input}
        label={FIELD_LABEL.login}
        onChange={onLoginChange}
      />

      <div className={styles.captchaContainer}>
        <div className={styles.captchaWrapper}>
          <img
            alt="captcha"
            className={styles.captcha}
            src={API_CAPTCHA + "?hash=" + captchaHash}
          />
          <span
            onClick={refreshCaptcha}
            className={styles.captchaRefresh}
          >
            <RenewIcon />
            Обновить изображение
          </span>
        </div>
        <Input
          className={styles.input}
          classNameInput={styles.inputCaptcha}
          placeholder={FIELD_LABEL.captcha}
          onChange={onCaptchaChange}
          value={captcha}
        />
      </div>

      {error && <span className={styles.error}>{error?.ErrorMessageText || error}</span>}


      <label className={styles.checkboxContainer}>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          checked={accessRestoreConsent}
          onChange={onAccessRestoreConsentChange}
          className={styles.checkbox}
        />
        <span className={styles.checkboxLabel}>
          <a href="https://s3.investpalata.ru/lp/access-restore-consent.pdf" className={styles.link} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Согласие на обработку персональных данных ООО "Инвестиционная палата"</a>.
          Подробнее об обработке данных в {" "}
          <a href="https://s3.investpalata.ru/lp/Политика конфиденциальности _ политика в отношении обработки ПДн (ред. 21.11.2025)(v4) (3).pdf" className={styles.link} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
            Политике
          </a>
          .
        </span>
      </label>


      <div className={styles.loginRestoreAgreement}>
        Нажимая «Далее» я подтверждаю заключение с ООО «Инвестиционная палата»{" "}
        <a href="https://s3.investpalata.ru/lp/edo_pep.pdf" className={styles.link}>
          Соглашения об использовании системы ЭДО и электронной подписи
        </a>
      </div>

      <div className={`${styles.restoreAgreement}`}>
        В случае возникновения ошибок в процессе взаимодействия с системой ЭДО просим обращаться на адрес электронной почты <a className={styles.link} rel="noopener noreferrer" href="mailto:clients_support@investpalata.ru">clients_support@investpalata.ru</a> для проверки специалистами Ваших анкетных данных.
      </div>

      <div className={styles.buttons}>
        <Button
          disabled={buttonDisabled}
          className={styles.button}
          onClick={onConfirmClick}
          title={loading === "pending" ? BUTTON_RESET_LOADING : BUTTON_RESET_VALUE}
          theme="accent"
        />
        <Button
          className={styles.button}
          title={BUTTON_RESET_CANCEL}
          theme="light"
          onClick={onCancelResetClick}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  )
}

export default memo(StepLogin);
