import { createSlice } from "@reduxjs/toolkit";
import { IHintsState } from "./hints.types";

const initialState: IHintsState = {
  hints: [],
  error: null,
  status: 'idle',
};

const hintsSlice = createSlice({
    name: "hints",
    initialState,
    reducers: {
      setStatus(state, action) {
        return {
          ...state,
          status: action.payload,
        }
      },
      setError(state, action) {
        return {
          ...state,
          error: action.payload,
        };
      },
      saveHints(state, action) {
        return {
          ...state,
          hints: action.payload || [],
        };
      },
    }
});

export const { saveHints, setError, setStatus } = hintsSlice.actions;

export default hintsSlice.reducer;

import { sendGetRequest } from "../../scripts/requests";
import { getUrlParams } from "../../scripts/helpers";

import { INewsProps, INewsByIdProps, INewsData, INewsByIdData } from "./types";
import { newsAdapter, singleNewsAdapter } from "./helpers";

export const fetchNews = async ({ categories, count, page }: INewsProps) => {
  const params = getUrlParams({ categories, count, page });

  const data: INewsData = await sendGetRequest({
    api: API_NEWS(params),
    options: { timeout: 5000 },
  }).catch(error => {
    console.log("error", error);
  });

  return newsAdapter(data);
};

export const fetchNewsById = async ({ id }: INewsByIdProps) => {
  const data: INewsByIdData = await sendGetRequest({
    api: API_SINGLE_NEWS_BY_ID(id),
    options: { timeout: 5000 },
  }).catch(error => {
    console.log("error", error);
  });

  return singleNewsAdapter(data);
};

import { createSlice } from "@reduxjs/toolkit";

const initialState = {
  otp: null,
  otpError: null,
  otpErrorCode: null,
  otpTryCount: 5,
  sms: "",
};

const otpSlice = createSlice({
  name: "otp",
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    saveOTP(state, action) {
      return {
        ...state,
        otp: action.payload,
      };
    },
    saveSms(state, action) {
      return {
        ...state,
        sms: action.payload,
      };
    },
    errorOTP(state, action) {
      return {
        ...state,
        otpError: action.payload.otpError,
        otpErrorCode: action.payload.otpErrorCode,
      };
    },
    minusTryCount(state) {
      return {
        ...state,
        otpTryCount: state.otpTryCount > 0 ? state.otpTryCount - 1 : 0,
      };
    },
    setInitialStateOtp() {
      return initialState;
    },
  },
});

export const { saveOTP, errorOTP, minusTryCount, setInitialStateOtp, saveSms } =
  otpSlice.actions;

export default otpSlice.reducer;

import { ERROR_TEXT_CODES } from "../../utils/mobileAppNotificator";
import { TTradeChangeType } from "./transfer.types";

import {
  IList,
  IListData,
  IOTP,
  IOTPData,
  ITransferAssetsData,
  ITransferAssetsFiles,
  ITransferAssetsFilesData,
  ITransferAssetsStatusData,
} from "./types";

export const listAdapter = (data: IListData, type?: TTradeChangeType): IList => {


  const obj = {};
  data.TransferAssets.forEach(item => {
    const index = `${item.Portfolio_Id}_${item.Product_Id}`;
    const formatedItem = {
      currencyCode: item.Currency,
      custodyId: item.Custody_Id,
      instrumentId: item.Instrument_Id,
      instrumentCode: item.InstrumentCode,
      instrumentName: item.InstrumentName,
      instrumentImageName: item.InstrumentImageName,
      isin: item.ISIN,
      tradePlaceId: item.TradePlace_Id,
      planVolume: item.PlanVolume,
      portfolioId: item.Portfolio_Id,
      price: item.Price,
      productId: item.Product_Id,
      productName: item.ProductName || item.ProductFullName,
      portfolioName: item.PortfolioName,
      uniqId: `${item.Portfolio_Id}_${item.Instrument_Id}`,
    };
    if (index in obj) {
      obj[index].push(formatedItem);
    } else {
      obj[index] = [formatedItem];
    }
  });
  // return Object.values(obj);
  return { list: Object.values(obj), state: data.TransferAssetsLimit[0].NewOrderState };

};

export const transferAssetsRequestAdapter = (
  data: ITransferAssetsData,
): string => {
  return data?.Request[0].Request_Id || "";
};

export const statusAdapter = (data: ITransferAssetsStatusData): string => {
  return data?.RequestStatus[0].Status || "";
};

export const filesAdapter = (
  data: ITransferAssetsFilesData,
): ITransferAssetsFiles => {
  return {
    crc: data?.ReferenceDocuments[0]?.CRC,
    displayName: data?.ReferenceDocuments[0]?.DisplayName,
    type: data?.ReferenceDocuments[0]?.Type
  };
};

export const filesAdapterArray = (
  data: any,
) => {

  return data?.ReferenceDocuments.map((file: any) => {
    return {
      crc: file?.CRC,
      displayName: file?.DisplayName,
      type: file?.Type
    };
  })
};

export const otpAdapter = (data: IOTPData): IOTP => {
  return {
    operationId: data?.OTPChallenge?.OperationId,
    phone: data?.OTPChallenge?.MaskedPhone,
    smsTryLeft: data?.OTPChallenge?.SmsTryLeft,
    timeout: data?.OTPChallenge?.Timeout,
  };
};

export const isSessionError = errorCode => {
  const {
    NO_SESSION,
    SESSION_CLOSED,
    SESSION_TOKEN_NOT_SPECIFIED,
    PERSON_NOT_FOUND,
  } = ERROR_TEXT_CODES;

  return [
    NO_SESSION,
    SESSION_CLOSED,
    SESSION_TOKEN_NOT_SPECIFIED,
    PERSON_NOT_FOUND,
  ].includes(errorCode);
};

export const isRequestError = errorCode => {
  const {
    REQUEST_GUID_NOT_SPECIFIED,
    REQUEST_NOT_FOUND,
    INVALID_REQUEST_STATE,
  } = ERROR_TEXT_CODES;

  return [
    REQUEST_GUID_NOT_SPECIFIED,
    REQUEST_NOT_FOUND,
    INVALID_REQUEST_STATE,
  ].includes(errorCode);
};

export const isSaveInstrumentsError = errorCode => {
  const {
    INSTRUMENT_NOT_FOUND,
    INSTRUMENT_NOT_SPECIFIED,
    SUB_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND,
    TRADE_PLACE_NOT_FOUND,
    TRADE_PLACE_NOT_SPECIFIED,
  } = ERROR_TEXT_CODES;

  return [
    INSTRUMENT_NOT_FOUND,
    INSTRUMENT_NOT_SPECIFIED,
    SUB_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND,
    TRADE_PLACE_NOT_FOUND,
    TRADE_PLACE_NOT_SPECIFIED,
  ].includes(errorCode);
};

export const isConfirmError = errorCode => {
  const {
    ILLEGAL_OPERATION,
    CONFIRMATION_CODE_NOT_SPECIFIED,
    WAITING_CONFIRMATION_REQUEST_STATUS_EXPECTED,
  } = ERROR_TEXT_CODES;

  return [
    ILLEGAL_OPERATION,
    CONFIRMATION_CODE_NOT_SPECIFIED,
    WAITING_CONFIRMATION_REQUEST_STATUS_EXPECTED,
  ].includes(errorCode);
};

import store from "./../../store";

import {
  API_LIST,
  API_TRANSFER_ASSETS,
  API_TRANSFER_ASSETS_SAVE,
  API_TRANSFER_ASSETS_COMMIT,
  API_TRANSFER_ASSETS_STATUS,
  API_TRANSFER_ASSETS_FILES,
  API_TRANSFER_ASSETS_FINISH,
  API_TRANSFER_ASSETS_VERIFY,
  API_TRADE_LAST,
  API_OTP_CONFIRM,
  API_OTP_RENEW,
} from "../../constants/API";

import { DEFAULT_TRADE_CHANGE_TYPE } from "./transfer.constants";

import { sendGetRequest, sendPostRequest } from "../../scripts/requests";

import {
  ERROR_CODES,
  ERROR_TEXT_CODES,
} from "../../utils/mobileAppNotificator";

import {
  setErrorValue,
  setComfirmStatus,
  setError,
  setLimitData,
} from "./transfer.slice";

import {
  saveOTP,
  errorOTP,
  minusTryCount,
  setInitialStateOtp,
} from "../otp/otp.slice";

import {
  filesAdapter,
  filesAdapterArray,
  isConfirmError,
  isRequestError,
  isSaveInstrumentsError,
  isSessionError,
  listAdapter,
  transferAssetsRequestAdapter,
  statusAdapter,
  otpAdapter,
} from "./helpers";
import { IGetTransferAssetsInstrumentsParams, IPostTransferAssetsParams } from "./transfer.types";

const errorHandler = ({ response, fromCatch = false, isConfirm = false }) => {
  if (response.Error) {
    const error = response.Error[0];

    store.dispatch(setError(error));
    
    const errorStatus = error?.Error;
    const errorCode = error?.ErrorCode;
    
    if (
      errorCode === ERROR_TEXT_CODES.SMS_CODE_CONFIRMATION_FAILED ||
      errorCode === ERROR_TEXT_CODES.SMS_TRY_COUNT_EXCEEDED ||
      errorCode === ERROR_TEXT_CODES.SMS_LIFE_TIME_EXPIRED
    ) {
      store.dispatch(
        errorOTP({
          otpError: response.Error[0].ErrorMessageText,
          otpErrorCode: response.Error[0].ErrorCode,
        }),
      );
      if (errorCode === ERROR_TEXT_CODES.SMS_CODE_CONFIRMATION_FAILED) {
        store.dispatch(minusTryCount());
      }
    } else {
      if (isConfirm) {
        if (isConfirmError(errorCode)) store.dispatch(setErrorValue({ error: "minorError", value: true }));
        if (+errorStatus > 300) store.dispatch(setErrorValue({ error: "criticalError", value: true }));
      }

      if (
        errorStatus === ERROR_CODES.ERROR_SESSION_CODE ||
        isSessionError(errorCode)
      ) {
        store.dispatch(setErrorValue({ error: "sessionError", value: true }));
      } else if (isRequestError(errorCode)) {
        store.dispatch(setErrorValue({ error: "requestError", value: true }));
      } else if (isSaveInstrumentsError(errorCode)) {
        store.dispatch(setErrorValue({ error: "technicError", value: true }));
      } else if (errorCode === ERROR_TEXT_CODES.TRANSFER_ASSETS_ALREADY_EXISTS) {
        return response;
      } else {
        store.dispatch(setErrorValue({ error: "technicError", value: true }));
      }
    }

    return null;
  } else {
    return response;
  }
};
export const fetchList = async ({ type }: IGetTransferAssetsInstrumentsParams) => {
  let data;
  await sendGetRequest({
    api: API_LIST(type),
  })
    .then(response => {
      const res = errorHandler({ response });
      store.dispatch(setLimitData(res?.TransferAssetsLimit?.[0]));
      
      data = res ? listAdapter(res, type) : [];
    })
    .catch(error => {
      errorHandler({ response: error, fromCatch: true });
      if (error.Error) {
        data = [data.Error[0]];
      }
    });
  return data;
};

export const transferAssetsRequest = async ({ type }: IPostTransferAssetsParams) => {
  let data;
  await sendPostRequest({
    api: API_TRANSFER_ASSETS,
    body: { type: type || DEFAULT_TRADE_CHANGE_TYPE },
  })
    .then(response => {
      const res = errorHandler({ response });
      const requestGuid = transferAssetsRequestAdapter(res);
      data = requestGuid;
    })
    .catch(error => {
      errorHandler({ response: error, fromCatch: true });
      data = error;
    });
  return data;
};

export const tradeLast = async () => {
  let data;
  await sendGetRequest({
    api: API_TRADE_LAST,
  })
    .then(response => {
      const res = errorHandler({ response });
      data = res;
    })
    .catch(error => {
      errorHandler({ response: error, fromCatch: true });
      data = error;
    });
  return data;
};

export const transferAssetsSave = async ({ instrument, requestId }) => {
  let data;
  await sendPostRequest({
    api: API_TRANSFER_ASSETS_SAVE,
    body: {
      instrument_Id: instrument.instrumentId,
      custody_Id: instrument.custodyId,
      portfolio_Id: instrument.portfolioId,
      product_Id: instrument.productId,
      request_Guid: requestId,
      tradePlace_Id: instrument.tradePlaceId,
      volume: instrument.volume,
    },
  })
    .then(response => {
      const res = errorHandler({ response });
      data = statusAdapter(res);
    })
    .catch(error => {
      errorHandler({ response: error, fromCatch: true });
      data = error;
    });

  return data;
};

export const transferAssetsCommit = async requestId => {
  let data;
  await sendPostRequest({
    api: API_TRANSFER_ASSETS_COMMIT,
    body: { request_Guid: requestId },
  })
    .then(response => {
      const res = errorHandler({ response });
      data = statusAdapter(res);
    })
    .catch(error => {
      errorHandler({ response: error, fromCatch: true });
      data = error;
    });

  return data;
};

export const transferAssetsStatus = async requestId => {
  let data;
  await sendGetRequest({
    api: API_TRANSFER_ASSETS_STATUS(requestId),
  })
    .then(response => {
      const res = errorHandler({ response });
      data = statusAdapter(res);
    })
    .catch(error => {
      errorHandler({ response: error, fromCatch: true });
      store.dispatch(setErrorValue({ error: "statusError", value: true }));
      data = error;
    });

  return data;
};

export const transferAssetsFiles = async requestId => {
  let data;
  await sendGetRequest({
    api: API_TRANSFER_ASSETS_FILES(requestId),
  })
    .then(response => {
      const res = errorHandler({ response });
      data = filesAdapter(res);
    })
    .catch(error => {
      errorHandler({ response: error, fromCatch: true });
      data = error;
    });

  return data;
};


export const transferAssetsFilesArray = async requestId => {
  let data;
  await sendGetRequest({
    api: API_TRANSFER_ASSETS_FILES(requestId),
  })
    .then(response => {
      const res = errorHandler({ response });
      data = filesAdapterArray(res);
    })
    .catch(error => {
      errorHandler({ response: error, fromCatch: true });
      data = error;
    });

  return data;
};


export const transferAssetsVerify = async ({ requestId, callback }) => {
  let data;
  await sendPostRequest({
    api: API_TRANSFER_ASSETS_VERIFY,
    body: { request_Guid: requestId },
  })
    .then(response => {
      const res = errorHandler({ response });
      const formattedData = otpAdapter(res);
      store.dispatch(saveOTP(formattedData));
      callback && callback(formattedData);
      data = formattedData;
    })
    .catch(error => {
      errorHandler({ response: error, fromCatch: true });
      data = error;
    });
  return data;
};


export const transferAssetsFinish = async ({ requestId, callback }) => {
  let data;
  await sendPostRequest({
    api: API_TRANSFER_ASSETS_FINISH,
    body: { request_Guid: requestId },
  })
    .then(response => {
      const res = errorHandler({ response });
      const formattedData = otpAdapter(res);
      store.dispatch(saveOTP(formattedData));
      callback && callback(formattedData);
      data = formattedData;
    })
    .catch(error => {
      errorHandler({ response: error, fromCatch: true });
      data = error;
    });
  return data;
};

export const transferAssetsConfirm = async ({ OTP, sms, callback }) => {
  let data;
  store.dispatch(setComfirmStatus('pending'));

  await sendPostRequest({
    api: API_OTP_CONFIRM,
    body: {
      OTP: sms,
      OperationId: OTP.operationId,
    },
  })
    .then(response => {
      errorHandler({ response, isConfirm: true });
      data = { success: !response.Error?.[0]?.Error };
      store.dispatch(setComfirmStatus(data?.success ? 'success' : 'failed'));
    })
    .catch(error => {
      errorHandler({ response: error, fromCatch: true, isConfirm: true });
      store.dispatch(setComfirmStatus('failed'));
      data = { success: false, error };
    });

  callback?.(data);
  return data;
};

export const transferAssetsRenew = async ({ operationId, callback }) => {
  let data;
  await sendPostRequest({
    api: API_OTP_RENEW,
    body: { OperationId: operationId },
  })
    .then(response => {
      errorHandler({ response });
      const formattedData = otpAdapter(response);
      store.dispatch(setInitialStateOtp());
      store.dispatch(saveOTP(formattedData));
      callback && callback(formattedData);
      data = formattedData;
    })
    .catch(error => {
      errorHandler({ response: error, fromCatch: true });
    });

  return data;
};

import { PayloadAction, createSlice } from "@reduxjs/toolkit";
import { ITransferErrorPayload, ITransferState } from "./transfer.types";
import { TLoadingState, IError } from "../types";
import { ITransferAssetsLimitData } from "./types";

const initialState: ITransferState = {
  requestGuid: "",
  technicError: false,
  statusError: false,
  sessionError: false,
  requestError: false,
  criticalError: false,
  minorError: false,
  error: null,
  inputsData: {},
  finalValue: 0,
  finalCount: 0,
  confirmStatus: 'idle',
  limitData: null,
};

const transferAssetsSlice = createSlice({
  name: "transferAssets",
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    setInitialState() {
      return initialState;
    },
    saveRequestGuid(state, action) {
      return {
        ...state,
        requestGuid: action.payload,
      };
    },
    setInputsData(state, action) {
      return {
        ...state,
        inputsData: action.payload,
      };
    },
    setFinalValue(state, action) {
      return {
        ...state,
        finalValue: action.payload,
      };
    },
    setFinalCount(state, action) {
      return {
        ...state,
        finalCount: action.payload,
      };
    },
    setError(state, action: PayloadAction<IError | null>) {
      return {
        ...state,
        error: action.payload,
      };
    },
    setErrorValue(state, action: PayloadAction<ITransferErrorPayload>) {
      const {error, value} = action.payload;
      return {
        ...state,
        [error]: value,
      };
    },
    clearErrors(state) {
      return {
        ...state,
        error: null,
        sessionError: false,
        requestError: false,
        statusError: false,
        criticalError: false,
        minorError: false,
        technicError: false,
      }
    },
    setComfirmStatus(state, action: PayloadAction<TLoadingState>) {
      return {
        ...state,
        confirmStatus: action.payload,
      };
    },
    setLimitData(state, action: PayloadAction<ITransferAssetsLimitData | null>) {
      return {
        ...state,
        limitData: action.payload,
      };
    }
  },
});

export const {
  setInitialState,
  clearErrors,
  saveRequestGuid,
  setInputsData,
  setFinalValue,
  setFinalCount,
  setError,
  setErrorValue,
  setComfirmStatus,
  setLimitData,
} = transferAssetsSlice.actions;

export default transferAssetsSlice.reducer;

import { IError, TLoadingState } from "../types";
import { ITransferAssetsLimitData } from "./types";

export default Object.freeze({
  SAVE_REQUEST_GUID: "SAVE_REQUEST_GUID",
});

export type TTransferErrorType = 
  "sessionError" |
  "requestError" |
  "statusError" |
  "criticalError" |
  "minorError" |
  "technicError";


export interface ITransferErrorPayload {
  error: TTransferErrorType;
  value: boolean;
}  

export interface ITransferState {
  requestGuid: string | null;
  technicError: boolean;
  statusError: boolean;
  sessionError: boolean;
  requestError: boolean;
  criticalError: boolean;
  minorError: boolean;
  error: IError | null;
  inputsData: Object | null;
  finalValue: number | null;
  finalCount: number | null;
  confirmStatus: TLoadingState;
  limitData: ITransferAssetsLimitData | null;
}

export type TTradeChangeType = "Qiwi" | "TransferAssets" | "ExchangeAssets";

export type TYSessionStateType = "CLOSED" | "ACTIVE";

export interface IGetTransferAssetsInstrumentsParams {
  type?: TTradeChangeType
}


export interface IPostTransferAssetsParams extends IGetTransferAssetsInstrumentsParams {}

  price?: number;
  productId?: number;
  productName?: string;

  uniqId?: string;
};

export interface ITransferAssetData {
  Currency: string;
  Custody_Id: number;
  ISIN: string;
  InstrumentCode: string;
  InstrumentImageName: string;
  InstrumentImageTime: string;
  InstrumentName: string;
  Instrument_Id: number;
  PlanVolume: number;

  Portfolio_Id: number;
  Price: number;

  ];
}

export interface ITransferAssetsStatusData {
  RequestStatus: [
    {
      Status: string;
      SmsTimeout: number;
      SmsTryCount: number;
      SmsLifeTime: number;
    },
  ];
}

export interface ITransferAssetsFilesData {
  ReferenceDocuments: [
    {
      Type: string;
      DisplayName: string;
      CRC: string;
    },
  ];
}

export interface ITransferAssetsFiles {
  crc?: string;
  displayName?: string;
  type?: string;
}

export interface IOTPData {
  OTPChallenge: {
    OperationId: string;
    MaskedPhone: string;
    Timeout: number;
    SmsTryLeft: number;
  };
}

export interface IOTP {
  timeout: number;
  phone: string;
  operationId: string;
  smsTryLeft: number;
}


--- FILE: src/entities/types.ts ---
import { IDocuments, IDocumentsById } from "./documents/types";
import { IEquities } from "./equities/types";
import { IFAQ } from "./faq/types";
import { INews, INewsById } from "./news/types";
import { IList } from "./transfer/types";

export interface ILoadedData {
  documents?: IDocuments;
  documentById?: IDocumentsById;
  faq?: IFAQ;
  news?: INews;
  newsById?: INewsById;
  salt?: string;
  list?: IList;
  equities?: IEquities;
}

export type TLoadingState = "idle" | "pending" | "success" | "failed";

export interface IError {
  /** код - статус ответа */
  Error?: string | number;
  /** код - наименование ошибки */
  ErrorCode?: string;
  /** сообщение */
  ErrorMessageText?: string;
}

--- FILE: src/entities/user/user.actions.ts ---
import userTypes from "./user.types";

export const savePhone = () => ({
  type: userTypes.SAVE_PHONE
});

--- FILE: src/entities/user/user.selectors.ts ---
import { useSelector } from "react-redux";

const selectUserData = ({ user }) => user;

export const useUserData = () => useSelector(selectUserData);



--- FILE: src/entities/user/user.slice.ts ---
import { createSlice } from "@reduxjs/toolkit";

const initialState = {
  phone: null,
};

const userSlice = createSlice({
  name: "user",
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    savePhone(state, action) {
      return {
        ...state,
        phone: action.payload
      };
    },
  },
});

export const { savePhone } = userSlice.actions;
export default userSlice.reducer;


--- FILE: src/entities/user/user.types.ts ---
export default Object.freeze({
  SAVE_PHONE: "SAVE_PHONE",
});

--- FILE: src/scripts/decimalAdjust/decimalAdjust.ts ---
import { MathValue, TRoundingType } from "./../types";

function decimalAdjust(
  type: TRoundingType,
  value: MathValue,
  roundingDigit?: MathValue,
) {
  // Если разряд для округления не определен, либо равен нулю
  if (typeof roundingDigit === "undefined" || +roundingDigit === 0) {
    return Math[type](+value);
  }

  // Если значение не является числом, либо разряд для округления не является целым числом
  if (
    isNaN(+value) ||
    !(typeof roundingDigit === "number" && roundingDigit % 1 === 0)
  ) {
    return NaN;
  }

  // Сдвиг разрядов
  const postShiftValue = Math[type](+(+value + "e" + -roundingDigit));

  // Обратный сдвиг
  return +(postShiftValue + "e" + roundingDigit);
}

export default decimalAdjust;

--- FILE: src/scripts/formatString.ts ---
const parts = [
  "а",
  "без",
  "в",
  "во",
  "вы",
  "до",
  "для",
  "за",
  "и",
  "из",
  "или",
  "к",
  "ко",
  "между",
  "на",
  "над",
  "не",
  "нет",
  "но",
  "о",
  "об",
  "около",
  "от",
  "перед",
  "по",
  "под",
  "при",
  "про",
  "с",
  "со",
  "то",
  "у",
  "чем",
  "через",
].join("|");

export const formatString = (string: string) => {
  if (typeof string !== "string" || !string.length) return string;

  const needSpaceBeforeArr = ["млн", "тыс", "млрд", "трлн", "$", "₽", "€"];
  const replacementsArray = string.match(/<.*?>/g) || [""];
  const trimmedString = replacementsArray.reduce(
    (acc, curr, index) => acc.replace(curr, `%%%${index}%%%`),
    string,
  );
  const partsRegexp = new RegExp(`( |^)(${parts})( |$)`, "gi");
  const needSpaceBeforeRegexp = new RegExp(
    `\\s(${needSpaceBeforeArr.join("|")})`,
    "g",
  );
  const quoteLeftRegexp = /[«'"`]([\wа-я])/gi;
  const quoteRightRegexp = /([\wа-я])[»'"`]/gi;
  const dashRegexp = /[ ](-|–|‒)/g;
  const priceRegexp = /\d+(\s\d{3})+/g;

  const formattedString = trimmedString
    .replace(partsRegexp, match => match.substr(0, match.length - 1) + "&nbsp;")
    .replace(needSpaceBeforeRegexp, match => match.replace(/\s/g, "&nbsp;"))
    .replace(priceRegexp, match => match.replace(/\s/g, "&nbsp;"))
    .replace(quoteLeftRegexp, "&laquo;$1")
    .replace(quoteRightRegexp, "$1&raquo;")
    .replace(
      dashRegexp,
      (match, p1, position) => `${position ? "&nbsp;" : ""}&mdash;`,
    );

  return replacementsArray.reduce(
    (acc, curr, index) => acc.replace(`%%%${index}%%%`, curr),
    formattedString,
  );
};


--- FILE: src/scripts/helpers.ts ---
import parseISO from "date-fns/parseISO";
import format from "date-fns/format";
import ru from "date-fns/locale/ru";
import en from "date-fns/locale/en-US";
import decimalAdjust from "./decimalAdjust";
import { TRoundingType } from "./types";

export const formatDateByPattern = (
  date: string | Date,
  pattern: string,
  dateInISO = true,
  lang = "ru",
) => {
  try {
    if (+pattern) throw new Error("pattern shouldn't be a number");

    return dateInISO
      ? format(parseISO(date as string), pattern, { locale: ru })
      : format(new Date(date), pattern, { locale: lang === "ru" ? ru : en });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`Ошибка при форматировании даты: ${error}`);
  }
};

export const formatDate = (date: string, lang = "ru") => {
  const dateParsed = parseISO(date);

  return formatDateByPattern(dateParsed, "dd MMMM yyyy", false, lang);
};

export const getUrlParams = params => {
  const paramsArr = Object.keys(params)
    .map(key => {
      if (params[key] !== undefined) {
        return `${key}=${params[key]}`;
      } else return "";
    })
    .filter(el => !!el?.length);

  return paramsArr?.length ? "?" + paramsArr.join("&") : "";
};

export const getCurrencySymbol = code => {
  const currencySymbols = {
    EUR: "€",
    GBP: "£",
    PNT: "пт",
    PRC: "%",
    RUB: "₽",
    USD: "$",
  };
  return currencySymbols[code] || code;
};

export const formatCurrency = (
  currency,
  numbersAfterPoint?: number,
  roundType?: TRoundingType,
) => {
  try {
    if (!(typeof currency === "string" || typeof currency === "number"))
      return currency;
    let curr = currency;

    curr = decimalAdjust(roundType || "round", curr, -(numbersAfterPoint || 2));
    const afterPointLength = curr.toString().split(".")[1]?.length;
    const toFixedLength = afterPointLength > 2 ? afterPointLength : 2;

    const [, left, right] =
      Number(curr)
        .toFixed(toFixedLength)
        .toString()
        .match(/^(.+?)([.,].+)?$/) || [];

    return left?.replace(/(\d)(?=(\d\d\d)+(\D|$))/g, "$1 ").concat(right || "");
  } catch (e) {
    return currency;
  }
};

export const isRuText = text => {
  if (typeof text !== "string") return false;

  const ruMatches = text.match(/[а-яА-ЯёЁ]/gi);
  const enMatches = text.match(/[a-zA-Z]/gi);

  return !enMatches?.length || ruMatches?.length > enMatches?.length;
};

export const compareToLowerCase = (a, b, strictMode = false) => {
  if (!a || !b) return false;
  const first = a.toLowerCase();
  const second = b.toLowerCase();
  if (strictMode) {
    return first === second;
  } else {
    return first.includes(second);
  }
};

export const canUseDOM = !!(
  typeof window !== "undefined" &&
  window.document &&
  window.document.createElement
);

export const removeStyles = text => {
  if (typeof text !== "string") return text;
  const newText = text.replace(/style\s?=\s?(['"]).*?\1/g, "");
  return newText;
};


--- FILE: src/scripts/requests.ts ---
import { IGetRequest, IPostRequest } from "./types";
import bowser from "bowser";

const xUserAgent = JSON.stringify({
  Type: "web",
  DeviceType: bowser.mobile || bowser.tablet ? "mobile" : "pc",
});

async function fetchWithTimeout(resource, options) {
  const { timeout } = options;

  const controller = new AbortController();
  const id = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeout);
  try {
    const response = await fetch(resource, {
      ...options,
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
    clearTimeout(id);

    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.log("fetch timeout error");
    return error;
  }
}

export const sendGetRequest = ({ api, callback, options }: IGetRequest) => {
  return fetchWithTimeout(api, {
    method: "GET",
    timeout: options?.timeout || 60 * 1000,
    ...(options && options),
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "X-User-Agent": xUserAgent,
    },
  })
    .then(response => {
      return response.json();
    })
    .then(data => {
      callback && callback(data);
      return data;
    })
    .catch(error => console.error(error));
};

export const sendPostRequest = ({
  api,
  body,
  callback,
  options,
}: IPostRequest) => {
  return fetchWithTimeout(api, {
    method: "POST",
    timeout: options?.timeout || 60 * 1000,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "X-User-Agent": xUserAgent,
    },
    ...(body && { body: JSON.stringify(body) }),
    ...(options && options),
  })
    .then(response => {
      return response.json();
    })
    .then(data => {
      callback && callback(data);
      return data;
    })
    .catch(error => console.log("fetch ERROR", error));
};

export const sendPostFileRequest = ({
  api,
  formData,
  callback,
  options,
}: {
  api: string;
  formData: FormData;
  callback?: (data: any) => void;
  options?: any;
}) => {
  return fetchWithTimeout(api, {
    method: "POST",
    timeout: options?.timeout || 60 * 1000,
    headers: {
      "X-User-Agent": xUserAgent,
    },
    body: formData,
    ...(options && options),
  })
    .then(response => {
      return response.json();
    })
    .then(data => {
      callback && callback(data);
      return data;
    })
    .catch(error => console.log("fetch ERROR", error));
};

--- FILE: src/scripts/useOutsideClick.ts ---
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";

const useOutsideClick = (initialValue, targetExceptions:string[]) => {
  const [isActive, setIsActive] = useState(initialValue);
  const ref = useRef(null);

  const handleClick = e => {
    if (
      ref.current &&
      !ref.current.contains(e.target) &&
      !targetExceptions.includes(e.target.id)
    ) {
      setIsActive(!isActive);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    document.addEventListener("click", handleClick);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("click", handleClick);
    };
  });

  return { ref, isActive, setIsActive };
};

export default useOutsideClick;

const { createProxyMiddleware } = require("http-proxy-middleware");

var devMWHostLk = require("./devMiddleProxyConfig.js").lkhost;
var devMWHostWeb = require("./devMiddleProxyConfig.js").webhost;

module.exports = function (app) {
  app.use(
    "/rs",
    createProxyMiddleware({
      target: "https://" + devMWHostLk,
      changeOrigin: true,
    }),
  );
  app.use(
    "/site",
    createProxyMiddleware({
      target: "https://" + devMWHostWeb,
      changeOrigin: true,
    }),
  );
  app.use(
    "/information_disclosure",
    createProxyMiddleware({
      target: "https://" + devMWHostWeb,
      changeOrigin: true,
    }),
  );
};

const store = configureStore({
  reducer: rootReducer
});

export type RootState = ReturnType<typeof store.getState>;
export type AppDispatch = typeof store.dispatch;

export const useAppDispatch: () => AppDispatch = useDispatch;
export const useAppSelector: TypedUseSelectorHook<RootState> = useSelector;

/** ___Grid___ */

@mixin on-mobile-small 
  @media only screen and (min-width: $gridMobileFirstMobileSmall) 
    @content
  


@mixin on-mobile-medium 
  @media only screen and (min-width: $gridMobileFirstMobileMedium) 
    @content
  


@mixin on-mobile-large 
  @media only screen and (min-width: $gridMobileFirstMobileLarge) 
    @content
  


@mixin on-tablet-medium 
  @media only screen and (min-width: $gridTabletMedium) 
    @content
  


@mixin on-desktop-small 
  @media only screen and (min-width: $gridMobileFirstDesktopSmall) 
    @content
  


@mixin on-desktop-medium 
  @media only screen and (min-width: $gridMobileFirstDesktopMedium) 
    @content
  


@mixin on-desktop-large 
  @media only screen and (min-width: $gridMobileFirstDesktopLarge)
    @content

*,

--- FILE: src/utils/mobileAppNotificator.ts ---
export const mobileAppNotificator = (
  msg: string | { eventName: string; params?: Record<string, unknown> },
) => {
  const preparedMsg = typeof msg === "string" ? msg : JSON.stringify(msg);

  if (window?.appInterface?.postMessage)
    window.appInterface.postMessage(preparedMsg);
  else if (window?.webkit?.messageHandlers?.iosApp?.postMessage)
    window.webkit.messageHandlers.iosApp.postMessage(preparedMsg);
};

export const ERROR_CODES = {

};

--- FILE: src/utils/scrollToAnchor.ts ---
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';

function ScrollToAnchor() {
  const location = useLocation();
  const lastHash = useRef("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (location.hash) {
      lastHash.current = location.hash.slice(1); // safe hash for further use after navigation
    }

    if (lastHash.current && document.getElementById(lastHash.current)) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        document
          .getElementById(lastHash.current)
          ?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
        lastHash.current = "";
      }, 100);
    }
  }, [location]);

  return null;
}

export default ScrollToAnchor;

--- FILE: values.yml ---
configMaps:
  nginx:
    data:
      default.conf: |
        server {
          listen       8080;
          location / {
            index  index.html;
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
            try_files $uri /index.html;
           }
          error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
          location = /50x.html {
            root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
           }
         }

# монтируем не каталог, а конкретный файл, иначе затрутся все остальные файлы в каталоге
volumeMounts:
- mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
  name: nginx
  subPath: default.conf

# вольюмы типов: secret, pvc, configMap
# items писать только если не все данные из configMap (в data) рассматривать в качестве файлов
volumes:
- name: nginx
  type: configMap

# 101 - id учетной записи nginx
podSecurityContext:
  fsGroup: 101
  runAsGroup: 101
  runAsUser: 101

replicaCount:
  _default: 1

resources:
  _default:
    limits:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 256Mi
    requests:
      cpu: 50m
      memory: 128Mi

startupProbe:
  failureThreshold: 10
  initialDelaySeconds: 20
  periodSeconds: 5
  successThreshold: 1

strategy:
  rollingUpdate:
    maxSurge: 25%
    maxUnavailable: 25%
  type: RollingUpdate

ingress:
  enabled: true
  annotations: {}
  hosts:
  - host:
      tt: x-tt.investpalata.ru
      prod: x.investpalata.ru
    paths:
    - path: /
      port: 8080

# variable ENV from helm command --set env.ENV=$TIER
env:
  NODE_ENV: production
